tei:div.tei:p: 'phags pa bzang so spyodargyal po'i 'grel ba bzhubaldom mgon sbu yi yongs r+sān khan chen a

'ji ba la 25 51 la spyorwarngosku༄4/ /de yang byang chub sems dpa'i sde sgod 'phags pa sdong pos brgyan pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs chen mo las/ bshes gnyen bkur ba'i spyod pa phyogs gcig pa'i be+e'u las la༄ rtsa po /kye no /go /ga la /ste /ciphyung ba sta/ nga da na bu ra bzang sa ba sa gnyan brgya rtsabargyad ba na nga / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po che la bamab pa'i mthar/ rgyal ba'i sras kyi thu bo kun tu bzang po'i phyag g.yas pa nor bzang gi spyi bor bzhag ste/ smon lam kun gyi rgyal po tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyi sgo nas btab pa bzang po spyod pa'i slon lam 'di la/ rnam bshad ji snyed cig bzhugs pa las/ da lam mkhas shing grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs pa dge ba'i /ga bsgo /sa bo /sa rta) poces cho /ste/ khob sa ga na na mkhan na 7a pad na ma ga gsung sgra sdud 'a ra thag nas bcos lhad med par 'bru len byas te/ yig sgog tu phab pa'i bzang spyod kyi rnam bshad 'di bzhin phal skad kyi sgog nas gsung yod stabs rgan gzhon dar gsum dang / slo rab 'bring tha gsum kun gyes bde blag tu rtogs nus pa zhig yin na/ 'di la brten nas sgong 7ga nyams len sgru rim pas rang gzhan thams cad 'phags pa nor bzang gi rnam thar 'chang ba'i byang chub sems dpa' sha stag tu 'gyur ba dang / dpar du bskrun pa'i dge bas yongs 'dzin dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po mchog sku tshe rgyal ba tshe mtha' yas pa'i ngo bor brtan cing / rmad byung thugs kyi bzhed dgongs chos bzhin 'grub pa'i slon 'dun shugs drag bcas/ 'phags yul rāja trir nas/ sa skya khri 'dzin pas/ phyi lo 209༷ zla ba 1༷ tshes 16 dge ba la5mas300/7 25sa 'im3 /92stuzu3ba5750lngakye 7 0 5'i39yo248009 07 3zukhru5 4 1sa spyo 73/ 91 135 2734081 snga'i〉 dzi/ 13ze—27348832ྈ 1 3yo5'ikhru31ba0'i'i70 ba

gleng gzhi/'jam mgon sku yi yongs 'dzin mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang yon tan bzang so mchog gi zhal gsung phan yodan tshad med pa dang ldan pa'i 'phags pa bzang sa sgod pa'i smon lam gyi rgyal po'i 'grel ba/ 'di ni 'phags sod kyi paṇa grub gong ma rnams kyi gsung rgyun la bla ma'i man ngag dang / mkhan rin sa che nyid kyi nyams myong gis brgyan pa'i zhal gsung drod mo zhig yin stabs/ 'di ni nang chos kyi gces nor kun gyi bang mdzod dang / gnad gsang sgol ba'i sde mig yin par nges/ 'on kyang yul skad dang brda dag bar gyi khyad par 'ga' zhig thun mong gis go bde bar sems nas brda dag bzhin bcos bsgyur cung tsam byas yod/ lhag par du 'ong sder nang du gsung sgos mi gsal ba rnams la bshad 'grel gzhan dang bsdur nas legs bsgrigs byas yod/ gang ltar yul skad kyi tshig lhad yan la ci lcogs kyis mkhan rin so che'i gsung sgos bzhin sodar bzhag byas yod/ bzang sgod kyi sa bcad 'di mkhan rin po nyid kyi gsung la gzhi bcol nas/tā ra na thā'i bzang spyodad kyi 'grel ba rgya cher 'grel dang / 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyi bzang spyod kyi don 'grel khog phug dang / mkhan po tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi bzang spyod kyi mchan 'grel sogs la mnyam bsdur byas nas zur du bton khul byas yod/ mdor na gang spyi'i thad thabs tshul yod dgu'i 'bad 'bung byed pa'i khul byas yod na yang / nyes tshogs mi nyung ba zhig yodad pa gdon mi za bas nyes pa 'di ni kho sos nyes pa nyag gcig lags pas/ mkhyen ldan gyi 1ga pa po rnams kyis yo bsrang dang / gnad smin gyi bka' slob/ nyams myong kyi phyogs sdom mi nyung ba zhig gnang ba'i re bskul dang / gar te legs pa'i cha zhig 'chis na de ni bla ma mnyes pa'i mchod pa dang / 'gro ba dgyis pa'i legs tshogs kyi rnam dkar yin pas/dpal ldan bla ma sku tshe brtan pa dang /mkha' mnyam yodangs la bde sh+yid 'byung ba'i rgyu ru baljo// //phab len pas//

klad kyi bye ra/1jog mar dge ba klad kyi don/1 greng gzhi'i sgo nas mtshams sbyar ba/ (1)2 mdo yi mtshan don 'grel bas sgo ba bskyed pa/ (3)3 'jug pa'i don du lhag lhar khyag 'tshal ba/ (5)2 bar du dge ba gzhung gi don/1 yan lag dang sto drug gi sgo nas bsdo rgyu'i dge rtsabasog pa/1 khyag 'tshal ba'i yan lag (6)2 mchod pa 'bul ba'i yan lag (13)3 sdig pa bshags pa'i yan lag (18)4 rjes su yi rang ba'i yan lag (20)5 chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bskul ba'i yan lag (22)6 bzhugs su gsodal ba'i yan lag (23)2 yan lag mtha' ma'i sgo nas bsags pa'i dge ba gzhan don du baljo ba/1 lhag bsam dag pa'i smon lam/ (26)2 byang chub kyi sems mi brjed pa'i sgon lam/ (31)ranyes pas ma gos pa 'khor bar skye ba'i sgon lam/ (35)4 sems can la phan pa dang bde ba'i sgon lam/ (37)5 go cha dang 'brel ba'i sgon lam/ (37)6 skal mnyam gyi grogs sa dag dang 'phrad pa'i sgon lam/ (39)7 dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten cing mnyes par byed pa'i sgon lam (40)8 sangs rgyas kyi zhal la blta ba'i smon lam/ (41)9 dam chos 'dzin pa'i sgon lam/ (42)

10 yon tan gyi mdzod thob pa'i slon lam/ (43)11 'jug pa du ma'i sgo nas zhing sgong ba'i sgon lam/1 sangs rgyas kyi zhal la blta bar 'jug pa'i sgon lam/ (45)2 sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams la 'jug pa'i sgon lam/ (45)3 sangs rgyas kyi gsung la 'jug pa'i smon lam (46)4 chos 'khor bskor ba la 'jug pa'i smon lam/ (48)5 rdzu 'phrul gyi gsung la 'jug thub pa'i sgon lam/ (48)6 rdzu 'phrul gyi spyod pa la 'jug thub pa'i smon lam/ (52)7 zhing sgong ba la 'jug pa'i rmon lam/ (53)8 ma byon pa'i mgon sto kun gyi drung du 'jug pa'i smon lam/ (54)12 stobs bsam gyi mi khyab pa thob pa'i smon lam/ (54)13 spang bya zad pa'i ye shes chen po ba pa'i smon lam/ (56)14 'gren las sna tshogs byed thub pa'i sgon lam/ (57)15 sangs rgyas dang byang sems kyi rjes su slob pa'i sgon lam/ (58)16 thams cad kyi don bsdu ba'i smon lam/ (62)3don bsdus pas bsdo ba/1 smon lam gyi mtha'/ (63)2 bzang sgod kyi phan yon/ (64)3 baljo ba nyid kyi sgo nas shin tu rgyas par bshad pa/1 byang chub sems dpa'i bldo ba'i rjes su 'jug pa/ (71)2 rgyal ba'i baljo ba la 'jug pa/ (73)3 mtha' mar dge ba 'jug gi don/1 bzang sbyod bton pa'i dge ba gzhan don du baljo ba/ (75)2 sgon lam rgyal po'i mjug byang / (77)

bzang sgod 'grel ba/ 1༄ོ/ /'phags pa bzang so spyodad pa'i smon lam gyi rgyal po'i 'grel ba bzhugs sod/ / /tshurke6kosde ༷/kakosha'alha5/༄7/ /zog mar dge ba klad kyi don/ bar du dge ba gzhung gi don/ mtha' mar dge ba 'jug gi don/ gsum las/ dang sa la/ speng gzhi'i sgo nas mtshams sbyar ba/ mdo yi mtshan don 'grel bas sgo ba bskyed pa/ 'jug pa'i don du lhag lhar phyag 'tshal ba/ dang po ni/'dis dus gsungs pa red bdag cag gi ston pa gnyan yod dze+e ta'i tshal na bzhugs pa'i skabs su/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs je ta'i tshal nas phroṃ lo gas snyo phyogs kyi grong khyer dze+ed pa'i 'byung gnas zhes pa der phebs 'gro dus/byang chub sems dpa' gzhon nu dor bzang 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rjes rjes su phebs song ba red/ de nas gzhon nu nor bzang la 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis bka' gnang ba red/ da khyed theg pa che po'i byang chub mche ga tu sems bskyed/ zeg pa chen po'i chedas la nyams len byed dgos dgongs pa de zhe drag yag so red/ byas tsang da zeg pa chen

2 mkhan chen a pad rin po che/so dge ba'i gshes gnyen mang sa bsten dgos red gsung pa red/de nas dang po byang chub sems dpa' nor bzang gis 'jam pa'i dbyangs la theg pa che po'i chos zer ba gang 'dra red/ de nyams len gang 'dra byed dgos zhes bka' dri zhus dus theg pa che po'i chos mang po gsungs pa red/de'i mjug tu 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis bka' gnang nas/ khyed rang 'di nas phyo yi phyogs na ri so mgur legs pa zer ba de na/ dge slong sprin gyi dpal zhes pa de yi sku mdun na song de ni chos zhu sa yin gsungs/de nas gzhon nu nor bzang der phebs nas de bzhin mdzad/ de nas bzung dge ba'i bshes gnyen snga ma snga ma rnams kyis phyi ma phyi ma rnams lung pa sa cha de na dge ba'i bshes gnyen de dang de 'dra yod red/ khyed rang de yi sgu mdun du song chos zhus zhes lung bstan gnang yong dus/ nor bzang gis dge ba'i bshes gnyen brgya dang brgyad tham pa'i sgu mdun nas chos zhus pa red/ de nas de'i mjug tu sngar gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen brgya dang brgya(da kyi sgu mdun nas chos mang sto zhus tshar dus/ gzhon nu nor bzang gis kun tu bzang sa dang 'jal ba red/ 'og min gyi zhing du sangs rgyas longs sku rnam snang gangs can mtsho de'i sgu mdun du byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po seng ge'i khri la bzhugs pa zhig dang mjal ba/ de ma zad phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams mang so/ dper na sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams kyi rdul phran gyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas mang po/ sangs rgyas de re re'i sgu mdun na kun tu bzang so re re bzhugs nas/ kun tu bzang po de tshang mas phyag g.yas brkyangs nas gzhon nu nor bzang gi da thog tu bzhag nas/ mnyam sor mgrin gcig tu bzang po spyodad pa'i sgon lam 'di gsungs pa

bzang spyod 'grel ba/ 3red/ byas tsang bzang so bye da pa'i sgon lam gsung mkhan de byang chub sems dpa' ku tu bzang so red/dus tshod de bdag cag gi ston pa rgya gar gyi gnyan yod dze+e ta'i tshal na gzhugs pa'i skabs su red/gnyis pa mdo yi mtshan don 'grel bas sgo ba bskyed pa/rgya gar skad du/ ar+ya bha dra tsar+ya pra ṇidha na rā dza/rgya gar skad du mdo 'di yi mtshan la de 'dra zhu ba red gsungs/sad skad du/ 'phags pa bzang so byedad pa'i sgon lam gyi rgyal sto/'phags pa bzang sto spyod pa'i sgon lam gyi rgyal po 'ar kyi red/ ar+ya zer na bod skad du 'phags pa/ bha dra zer na bzang sa/ tsar+ya zer na spyod pa red/ pra ṇi dha na zer na sgon lam/ rā dza zer na rgyal po/ de'i don dag ga re red zer na/'phags pa zer na bsdod bya byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang sto dang sbyar na/ kun tu bzang po 'phags pa'i gang zag red/ 'phags pa'i gang zag zhes pa de che sa thams cad kyi gnas lugs mngon sum du gzigs tshar ba de tsho la 'phags pa zer ba red/ 'phags zer na go sas yar mthon po'i sar srebs song ba la zer/ so so'i skye bo'i sa las ring du 'phags song bas na 'phags pa zes myang 'das kyi mdo la yang 'phags pa zer gyi yod red/ dper na 'phags pa brgyad stong pa lta bu/ de la bshad na de bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab red/ gsung rab de gzhan bstan bcos la sodags pa brdzod pa thams cad las khyad par du 'phags pa yin pas na 'phags pa zer/ gang bshad kyang gcig pa red/ bzang po sgod pa zer dus/ spyir 'di'i nang du bzang so sbyod pa zer ba mang so yong gi red/ de byang chub sems pa'i

4 mkhan chen a pad rin po che/sgod pa red/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yongs rdzogs la bzang po'i sgod pa zer na yang 'grig gi red/ byang chub sems dpa'i nang nas byang chub sems pa kun tu bzang sto'i sgod pa yin stabs bzang sto'i sbyod pa zer na yang 'gal ba yod ma red/ sgon lam zer na byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang sto la mdzad chos mang so yod pa'i nang nas sgon lam yin pas na smon lam zer ba red/ sgon lam zer na/ sgrer snyangs 'dod pa'i yul gcig thob dgos kyi bsam pa'i 'dun pa/ dper na sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob dgos bsam pa'i 'dun pa/ gzhung gi nang du 'dun pa dang sems pa gnyis gtso bo yin gsung pa red/ de'ang 'phags pa byams pa mgosan sos/ brtan pa rnams kyi sgon lam ni/ /sems pa 'dun dang bcas pa'o/ /zhes 'dun pa zer ba de sems byung gcig red/ yul de thob dgos kyi bsam pa de 'dun pa red/sems pa zer ba de sems des yul de dran du bcug pa'am/ sems de yul la khrid 'gro mkhan sems byung gcig la zer gyi red/ da de gnyis gtso stor byas pa'i mnyam du sems sems byung mang po zhig yodad red/ 'dun pa gtso stor gyur pa'i sems sems byung de tsho la sgon lam zer/ spyir stangs baljo ba dang sgon lam zhes pa gnyis bshad pa red/ de'i don dag sgon lam zhes pa de bye red/ baljo zhes pa de bye brag yin zes sgon lam zhes pa de dge rtsagacig yod med la ma bstos pa ste/ sgon lam dge rtsayod pa yang yod red/d+mad pa yang yod red/ baljo ba zhes pa de dge ba'i rtsab gcig la dmigs nas dge ba'i rtsab 'dis 'bras bu de 'dra zhig gi rgyu ru 'gyur dgos bsam pa de la bsngo ba zer gyi yod red/ rgyu mtshan de bas na bsngo ba de'i don la

bzang sgod 'grel ba/ 5sgon lam 'dres sdad yod pa red/ yang bsngo ba dang smon lam kha kha yin zer mkhan yang yodad sa red/ dper na/ bsodad nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ /zhes pa nang bzhin dang / phyag 'tshal ba dang mche da cing bshags pa dang / /rjed su yi rang bsgul zhing gsol ba 'debs/ /dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa/ /zhes pa nang bzhin dge ba'i rtsab 'dis 'bras bu 'di thob dgos bsam nas sgon pa byed pa de la bsngo ba zer/ de 'dra dge rtsagacig dmigs bsal ma bzung bar/ dper na/ 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs pa/ /zhes pa lta bu sgon lam zer gyi yod red/ de gnyis so so yin pa'i dbang du byas na mdo 'di bsngo ba yin zer rgyu yin pa red/ dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa/ /thams cad bdag gis byang chub byer bsngo'o/ /zhes dge rtsagacig rgyur byas nas bsngo ba byas pa yin pa red/ gang gis bgro ba'i rgyal po 'di zos nas/ /zhes baljo ba yin gsungs pa red/byas tsang smon lam zer/ rgyal so zhes pa ni rgyal po dang 'dra ba yin pas na rgyal po 'ar ba red/ dper na rgyal sa che po gcig gi 'og la rgyal phran mang po yodad red/ rgyal phran mang po'i mnga' khongs thams cad rgyal po che po gcig gi 'og 'dus yod red/ dpe de bzhin du sgon lam gyi mdo 'di'i nang du sgon lam gyi mdo mang po 'du ba yin tsang / mdo 'di nas bshad pa'i sgon lam gyi nang du sgon lam thams cad 'du ba yin tsang sgon lam gyi rgyal sa zhes gsungs pa red/gsum pa 'jug pa'i do/na du lhag lhar phyag 'tshal ba/'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nu gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo /

6 mkhan chen a pad rin po che/zhes lo tsā ba rnams kyis brjod pa red/ lo tsā ba rnams kyis 'gyur byed pa'i don du bar chad med pa la sogs pa'i dgos pa gzigs nas 'jam dpal dbyangs la 'gyur phyag byas pa red/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa/gzhon nu zer dgos ya de 'jam dpal gyi rtogs pa yin gsungs kyi 'dugagazhon nu lo brgyad pa'i tshul gyi sgu gzugs 'dzin byas nas sems can gyi don gnang mkhan yin dus tsa na gzhon nur gyur ba de la phyag 'tshal ba yin gsungs pa red/bar du dge ba gzhung gi don la/ yan lag dang so drug gi sgo nas baljo rgyu'i dge rtsabasodag pa/ yan lag mtha' ma'i sgo nas bsags pa'i dge ba gzhan don du baljo ba/ bsngo ba nyid kyi sgo nas shin tu rgyas par bshad pa dang gsum/dang sa la/ phyag 'tshal 'tshal ba'i yan lag mche da pa 'bul ba'i yan lagasdig pa bshags pa'i yan lag jes su yi rang ba'i yan lag che sa 'khor bskor bar bsgul ba'i yan lag bzhugs su gsodal ba'i yan lag dang so phyag 'tshal ba'i yan lag la/ mdor bstan pa dang / rgyas par bshad pa gnyis las/ dang so ni/da mdo dngos 'chad pa la/ bgro rgyu'i dge rtsabasog pa dang / bsags pa'i dge rtsabaljo ba dang bcas don tshan gnyis/ dang yo dge rtsabasags pa de las gcig baljo ba de bzhag nas yan lag drug yod red/ phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa sogs drug yod red/ de'i nang nas dang po khyag 'tshal ba ni/ji sted su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na/ /

bzang spyod 'grel ba/ 7dus gsum gshegs pa mi yi seng ge kun/ /bdag gis ma lus de dag thams cad la/ /lus dang ngag yid dang bas phyag bgyi'o/ /phyag 'tshal ba de la spyi dang bye brag gnyis/dang po spyir lus ngag yid gsum so sor ma phye nas phyag 'tshal ba/ de nas lus ngag yid gsum so sor bye nas phyag 'tshal ba gnyis las/ dang sa lus ngag yid gsum bye yi phyag 'tshal ba ni/ ji snyed zer na mang po'i don dag red/ su dag zer na yang mang so red/ ji snyed zhes pa sgod kyi 'jig rten/ su dag zhes pa bcud kyi sangs rgyas la sbyar dgos/shar la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten ji sted pa na ste/ phyogs bcu na 'jig rten mang sa yod red/ de'ang gcig tsam ma yin pa ji snyed yod pa'i phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na/ su dag zhes pa'i sgra de sangs rgyas la sbyar dgos/ su dag zhes pa ni sangs rgyas yod tshad med tshad kyi don dag red/ dus gsum gshegs pa mi yi seng ge kun zhes pa ni/ dus gsum du gshegs shing byon pa'i/ mi yi seng ge ste sangs rgyas de tshos rnam pa mi yi rnam pa bstan pas na mi/ su gang la yang zhed mi dgos pa gzhan thams cad zil gyis gnon pa sogs kyis seng ge dang 'dra sto yin pas na mi yi seng ge zer ba red/ don du dus gsum gyi mi yi seng ge sangs rgyas kun zhes phyag 'tshal ba'i yul red/ phyag 'tshal mkhan su yin zhe na bdag gis phyag 'tshal bar bgyi/ 'tshal ba'i yul de yang dus gsum gyi mi yi seng ge ma lus pa de dag thams cad la/ mi yi seng ge kun zhes pa dang / bdag gi ma lus de dag zhes pa dang / de dag

8 mkhan chen a pad rin po che/thams cad la zhes pa sogs gsum po dag yod tshad me+ed tshad kyi don dag red/ nan gtan byas nas gsung pa red/ dngos gnas byas na dus gsum gshegs pa mi yi seng ge kun/ ma lus de dag thams cad la/ de'i gsham nas bdag gis zhes bshad na go bde sa red/ de dag phyag 'tshal ba'i yul red/ tshul ji ltar 'tshal zhe na/ phyag 'tshal ba so bdag gis lus dang bas/ngag dang bas/ yid dang bas te dang ba gsum gyi sgo nas phyag bgyi'o zhes phyag 'tshal gyi yin gsung pa red/dang bas zhes pa yid gcig pu ma yin pa gsum gang la sbyar na yang 'grig gi yod red/ dang ba zhes pa sems kyis dad pa red/ lus dang bas zhes pa sems kyis dad pa byas pa'i sgo nas lus kyis phyag 'bul gyi yod bsam/ de bzhin ngag dang yid la yang sbyar/gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la lus yid ngag gsum so sor phyag 'tshal ba gsum yod pa las/ dang sto lus kyi sgo nas phyag 'tshal ba/bzang so spyod pa'i sgon lam stobs dag gis/ /rgyal ba thams cad yid kyis mngon sum du/ /zhing gi rdul snyed lus rab brtsad pa yis/ /rgyal ba kun la rab tu phyag 'tshal lo1/ /bzang sto spyod pa zer na kun tu bzang so'i spyod pa yin tsang bzang sa spyod pa'i sgon lam gsungs pa red/ stobs dag gi zhes pa bzang so spyod pa'i sgon lam gyi brjod bya la dad pa byas pa'i stobs dag gis/ sangs rgyas la sogs pa la ma dad pa la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa thams cad zil gyis gnon pa'i sgo nas/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sangs rgyas thams cad rang gi

bzang sgod 'grel ba/ 9yid kyis mngon sum du yod par bsam nas/ dngos su mazong thub kyi yod ma red de mngon sum lta bu gsal sar yod bsam nas/ de nas lus sa de'ang da lta lus po gcig pu ma yin pa/lus yo mang sa yodad bsam nas phyag 'tshal dgos gsungs pa red/ lus sa ga tshod yod zhe na/ zhing gi rdul snyed de/ zhing zer na sangs rgyas kyi bzhugs sa'i 'jig rten la zer gyi yod red/sangs rgyas bzhugs sa yi 'jig rten de la bsam gyi mi khyab pa yod red/dung phyur bye ba mang po de 'dra'i zhing khams de na rdul phran te/ rdul phran zer na dngos po chung shos de rdul phran red/ rdul phran gyi grangs ka ji sted yod pa de snyed kyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i lus mang so yod bsam/ lus rab tu btud pa ste lus thams cad kyis gus zhabs dang bcas pa'i sgo nas/ lus dang bas phyag 'tshal zer na lus kyis gus zhabs byas pa la go san yang 'grig gi yodad red/ rgyal ba kun la rab tu phyag 'tshal lo zhes/ sangs rgyas thams cad mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i drung na/ rang gis lus so mang po zhig sprul nas lus po thams cad kyis gus bdud dang bcas pa'i sgo nas phyag 'tshal gyi yond bsam/ yan lag bdun pa zer ba de dge ba bsags pa la gnad che po red/ dper na phyag 'tshal ba yin na phyag re re 'tshal na yang rang gi gzugs po de yi 'og tu sa yi cha shas ji tsam mnan yod na/ de nas dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi la thug gi bar du sa yi rdul phran re re bzhin kyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i mtho ris kyi lus rten zob pa dang / mazo ris kyi rgyal sa yi lus rten zob pa sogs kyi bsod nams mang so bsog pa gsungs pa red/ mdo yi nang du sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo zhes tshig brdzod pa tsam

10 mkhan chen a pad rin po che/gyis kyang mtho ris kyi lus rten mang so thob pa sogs gsungs pas phan yon che po red/gnyis pa yid kyis phyag 'tshal ba ni/rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed sangs rgyas rnams/ /sangs rgyas sras kyi dbus na bzhugs dag /de ltar chos kyi dbyings rnams ma lus pa/ /thams cad rgyal ba dag gis gang bar mos/ /rdul zhes pa rdul phran chung shos red/ nang pa'i theg pa 'og ma kha shas kyis cha shas bgo rgyu ched pa'i cha med yin zer gyi yod red/ cha shas yod sped la rtsod pa yod red de/ rdul chung shos sam phra shos de la zer gyi yod red/de 'dra yi rdul phra rab gcig gi steng na/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams la rdul phran gyi grangs ka ji snyed yod pa de snyed kyi sangs rgyas bzhugs yod bsam/sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams zhes pa lung pa gcig lta bu ma red zhe drag rgya che so red/ de na rdul phran chung chung dpe dang tshad bzung du me+ed pa mang sa yod red/ de 'dra zhig gi grangs ka yod pa'i sangs rgyas dpe ma/nga po bzhugs yod bsam/ sangs rgyas rnams kyang sku rkyang ma yin pa sras byang chub sems dpa' dang bcas pa/ sangs rgyas kyi sras zhes pa ni byang chub sems dpa'/byang sems brgya stong mang so'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas/ rdul phran gcig gi steng du sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams kyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas bzhugs yod bsam/ de'ang rdul phran gcig rkyang nga/ ma yin pa/ de ltar zhes pas rdul phran gcig gi steng du rdul snyed kye sangs rgyas

bzang spyod 'grel ba/ 11bzhugs pa de ltar du/ chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa'i phyogs thams cad de/che sa kyi dbyengs kyis gar khyab pa'i phyogs sam nam mkhas gar khyab pa'i phyogs ma lus pa thams cad na/ rgyal ba dag gis te sangs rgyas dag gis gang ba'i mos pa byed dgos kyi red gsungs/ dper na rdul phran gcig gi steng na rdul snyed kyi sangs rgyas bzhugs pa de nang bzhin gyis nam mkhas gar khyab pa'i phyogs thams cad na rdul snyed kyi sangs rgyas bzhugs yodad bsam pa de yid kyi phyag 'tshal ba'i don dag yin pa red/ mdor na 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul phran re re'i steng du rdul snyed kyi sangs rgyas bsam gyi mi khyab pa de 'dra bzhugs yond bsam/gsum pa ngag gi sgo nas phyag 'tshal ba ni/de dag bsngags pa mi zad rgya mtsho rnams/ /dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra kun gyis/ /rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan rab brjod cing / /bde bar gshegs pa thams cad bdag gis bstod/ /de dag zer na sangs rgyas mang po de dag spyir stangs bsngags pa zer ba ni/ sher phyin gyi nang du bstod bkur bsngags gsum zhes pa zhig gsungs pa red/ de dus bstod pa zer na ོ/na tan brjod pa chung chung / bkur ba yon tan brdzod pa 'bring po/ bsngags pa yon tan brdzod pa che sto gsungs pa red/ yin na yang 'di nang gi bsngags pa dang bstod pa gnyis gsungs 'dug dper na bde bar gshegs pa bdag gis bstod zhes pa dang / de dag bsngags pa zhes pa lta bu/ de gnyis kyi go don sde so so 'byed dgos

12 mkhan chen a pad rin po che/yin pa red/ bsngags pa zhes pa yon tan la go dgos kyi red gsungs kyi 'dug sangs rgyas de dag gis bsngags par byed pa'i yon tan mi zad pa/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan zer ba ni/ dper na nga tsho mi gcig gi yon tan kha bde sa zhig gis bshad na yang zhe drag rgyun ring po bshad rgyu yod ma red/ sangs rgyas kyi yodan tan ni byang chub sems dpa' sodags mkhas pa su 'dra zhig gis bshad na yang rdzogs ya gtan nas yod ma red/ rdzogs ya d+mad pa zad cung tsam nyung du 'gro ya yang yod ma red/ de tshad sed pa yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis red/ dper na nam mkha' zer rgyu de tshad ched pa yin dus 'di nas shar phyogs su dpag tshad pa bdun byen nas/ da shar phyogs kyi nam mkha' de rdzogs yod red dam zhe na/ rdzogs ped pa ma zad cung zad tsam thung du yang phyin yond ma red/ de nam mkha' la tshad med pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis nub phyogs kyi nam mkha' de cung tsam ring shar phyogs kyi nam mkha' de cung tsam thung du phyin yod ma red/ dpe de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi yon tan de zad ya ped pa zhig yin dus mi zad pa/ rgya che sa yin pas rgya mtsho lta bu de rnams zhes sangs rgyas kyi yon tan bshad pa red/ de la bstod pa yul ba'i tshig de la dbyangs 'azen dgos kyi yod red/ nga tshos dus rgyun bstod pa 'bul na gdangs dbyangs byed kyi yod red/ dbyangs ga tso zhig gis zhe na/ dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra skad kyis te/ dbyangs kyi yan lag 'dra mi 'dra 'gyur khug 'degs pa/ 'jog pa/ phra ba/ sgom pa sodags rgya mtsho lta bu'i sgra skad kyis te yan lag ma 'dra ba mang stos sgra skad kyis/ bstod pa'i tshig de dbyangs yan lag ma 'dra ba mang sos dang bcas te/ rgyal ba

bzang spyod 'grel ba/ 13kun gyi yon tan rab tu brjod pa'i sgo nas/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad bdag gis bstod/ bstod zhes pa don dag des snga ma de bshad pa red rgyal ba kun gyi yodan tan rab tu brjod ste/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad bdag gis bstod kyi yo da bsam na de ngag gi sgo nas phyag 'tshal ba zhes pa de red/ des khyag 'tshal ba phyin pa red/ phyag 'tshal ba des bsod nams che po bsog pa ma zad/ des nyes pa'am sdig pa yang sgong gi yod red/ spyir sdig pa thams cad sbyongang gi yodad de/ khyad par du des gus zhabs byas pa yin dus nyon mongs pa nga rgyal dang nga rgyal gyi kun nas bslangs ba'i las mi dge ba mang po byed kyi yod red/ dper na nga drag ga yin snyam pa'i nga rgyal lta bu/ dngos gnas byas na byang chub sems pa rnams la nga mi thams cad kyi nang nas dman shegs yin snyam pa'i bsam blo zhig dgos kyi yodad red/ de ma byung na dus rgyun du yag sa yin bsam pa de yod red des rkyen pas nyes pa mang sa byed kyi yod red/ thams cad 'dag thub kyi yod ma red de gang byas de sgong ba'i gnyen sto byed kyi yod red/gnyis pa mchod pa 'bul ba'i yan lag bla na yod pa'i mchod pa/ bla na d+mad pa'i mchod pa/ phyag mchod gnyis kyi mjug bsdu bstan pa/ dngapo ni/yan lag bdun po de tsho snga ma snga las phyo ma phyi ma phan 〈snan che bas/ phyag 'tshal ba las mchosad pa phul ba/ mche da pa las bshags pa phan yodan che ba dang / thams cad las bsngo ba phan yon che/ mchod pa la de bla na yod pa'i mchod pa dang / bla na ched pa'i mchod pa gnyis/ bla na zhes pa ni de'i gong na/gong na yod pa'i ma/chod pa gcig dang / gong na gtan nas ched pa'i mchod pa

14 mkhan chen a pad rin po che/gcig dang gnyis bshad pa red/ dang sto gong na yod pa'i mchod pa tog tsam dman pa red/me tog dam pa phreng ba dam pa dang / /sil snyan rnams dang byug pa gdugs mchog dang / /mar me mchog dang bdug sgos dam pa yis/ /rgyal ba de dag la ni mchod par bgyi/ /che tog zer na pad+ma la sogs pa/ dam pa zer na yag so'am sdig pas ma gos pa ste sdig dang bcas pas sgrub dgos pa ma yin pa/ srog chags dang ma 'dres pa'i me tog phreng ba zer na rin po che g.yu dang byur ru la sogs pa la bzos bzhag pa'i phreng ba/ yang na me+e tog brgyus bzhag pa'i phreng ba/ dam pa gcig pa red/ de re re bzhin du so sos dngos su phul na de yo red/sems kyis bsam na re re bzhin du mchod dz+was nam mkha' gang 'gro ba yod bsam/ sil snyan zer na snyan lam du 'bud rdung dkrol gsum byed ya yi sil snyan/ me tog dang phreng la sogs pa ni sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sgu gzugs spyi la mchod pa/ sil snyan de tsho snyan la 'bul gyi yod red/ byug pa zer na tsan dan la sogs pa dri bzang la bzos bzhag pa de thugs ka la byug ya dri chab zhes pa de red/ de nas gser gyis yu ba byas bzhag pa'i gdugs la rin sto che'i rgyan cha yod mkhan dar gyi na bza' la sogs pa la bzos bzhag pa'i gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan ba dan la sogs pa dbu la 'phub ya red/ mar mai zer na nged tshos mar khu las bzos bzhag pa'i mar che/ de min pa rin so che 'od dang ldan pa nyi ma dang zla ba la sogs pa/ de tsho

bzang sgod 'grel ba/ 15sbyan la snang ba'i ched dam gsal bar byed pa'i ched du/ mchog zhes pa dang dam pa zhes pa de dag don dag gcig pa red sdig pas ma gos pa dang yag po'i don red/ bdug sgos zer na me la sreg yong dus dri ma zhim sa dro rgyu yod mkhan de tsho red/ de shangs la 'bul ya red/ de dag zhes pa rgyal ba mang sto rdul gcig gi steng na rdul snyed kyi sangs rgyas de 'dra ba'i chos kyi dbyings kyis gar khyab kyi rgyal ba de dag thams cad la mchod pa 'bul gyi yod bsam nas mchod pa bgyi/na bza' dam pa rnams dang dri mchog dang / /bye ma phur ma ri rab mnyam pa dang / /bkod pa khyad par 'phags pa'i mchog kun gyis/ /rgyal ba de dag la ni mchod par bgyi/ /chos gos rnam pa gsum la sogs pa na bza' dam pa sgu lus kyi stod smad la 'bul ya/ dri mchog zer na ma sreg par dri zhim po zo mkhan de la dri mchog zer/ bye ma'i phur ma ri rab mnyam pa zer na gur gum dang / a gar ru la sogs pa'i dri zhim sa yod mkhan de tsho/ ras bzang pos thum so byas bzhag pa la bye ma'i phrar ma zer red/ de tsho gong nas gong du do bo mang po brtsig bzhag pa ri rab dang mnyam pa/ ri rab dang mnyam pa gong ma rnams la yang nam mkha'i khams gang ba dang ri rab dang mnyam pa la sogs zhes sbyar/ bkod pa khyad par 'phags pa zhes pa ste/ bkod pa zhes pa phal skad du bshams bkod/ sgrigs stangs legs sa byas pa red/ yin na yang 'dir rgya gar gyi 'grel ba rnams kyi nang du bkod pa zer na tshogs pa la zer kyi

16 mkhan chen a pad rin po che/yodad gsungs kyi 'dug de tshogs pa la bshad na mastod pa'i tshogs mang sto zhes pa'i don red/ mchod pa'i tshogs mang sto dang khyad par du 'phags pa'i mche ga kun gyis/ su la mchodad pa yin zhe na/ rgyal ba de dag la ni mtshongad par bgyi zhes/ so sos chog ga 'dra so 'don dus phar gir mchod rdzas 'dra bo gshams byas/ de tsho dmigs rten byas nas nam mkha'i khams kheng ba'i 'asgo ba de 'dra yodad de tsho 'bul gyi yodad bsam na/ snang ba thams cad sems kyis bzos pa yin tsang sems kyis yag po bsam thub na dngos su phul dang khyad par yod ma red gsungs kyi 'dug bsam ma thub pa yin na khyad par che sa 'asgo yi yod red/gnyis pa bla na med pa'i mche da pa/mche da pa gang rnams bla med rgya che ba/ /de dag rgyal ba thams cad la yang modas/ /mchod pa gang rnams zhes ni mchod rdzas kyi ngo bo de gong du bshad pa'i spe tog la sogs pa de tsho red gsungs kyi 'dug bla med zer na bla na d+mad pa'i mchod pa/ bla na ped pa'i mchod pa zer dgos ya de yang / gong du bshad pa'i me tog la sogs pa de tsho 'jig rten na yod pa'i me tog sogs red/ de tsho zag bcas kyi las dang nyon mongs pa las byung ba red/ da lta 'di bla na ped pa zer rgyu de byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa'i gang zag rnams kyis ting bhe ༵/dzishā bhe bhepy-i ṭ+wāṃdhi rdzudat+t+waṃ rdodīs laṭ+wāṃrdo spri dītram̐ bye rdo rdzuzlo 'irdza rngo~X dī dze+edze+e/ rgya che ba zer na mche da rdzas de rnams kyis chos kyi dbyings rnams thams

bzang spyod 'grel ba/ 17cad khyab par gyur pa yin tsang rgya che ba zer/ de lta bu bla na sped pa mchod pa de dag rgyal ba rnams la mche da par mo sa te phul bar bsam/gsum pa phyag mchesad gnyis kyi mjug bsdu bstan pa/bzang sa spyod la dad pa'i stobs dag gis/ /rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi/ /bzang po sbyod la zer na byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang so'i mchod pa phul ba'i spyod pa/ kun tu bzang pos mchod pa phral ba dang sgon lam btabs pa ched du bsngags brjod byed dgos red zhes bstan pa red/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dang bcas pa'i mchosad pa'i rdzas bsam gyi mi khyab pa sbrul nas/ byedags bcu'i sangs rgyas la mchod pa 'bul kyi yod red/ kun tu bzang pos mchod pa phul ba'i spyod pa la dad pa byas pa'i stobs dag gis/ rang gis yang snying ga nas kyang mche da dz+was mang sa nam mkha'i khams khengs ba sprul nas rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod pa 'bul bar bgyi gsungs/ de mchod pa 'bul ba red/ mdo yi nang du gsungs pa red sangs rgyas la dmigs nas me tog re tsam yul bzhag na yang mazo ris kyi skye ba mang sa zob pa gsungs pa red/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' de tsho yon gnas dam pa 'brel tshad don ldan yin dus/ don dag d+mad pa gtan nas mi yong pa don che so 'grub kyi yod red/ bsam blo gtong dgos ya gcig la sangs rgyas dngos su da lta 'di na phebs nas de la mchod pa phul ba dang / so sos sangs rgyas da lta ma 'jal na yang sangs rgyas phral ba'i mos pa byas yul bzhag pa gnyis la

18 mkhan chen a pad rin po che/khyad par med pa'i bsam blo gcig dgos kyi red/ de la khyad par yod pa de so sos sangs rgyas la dad pa ma byung ba yin pa red/ sangs rgyas de mkhyen pa la chags thogs sed pa yin pa de bsam blo btangs na khyad med pa'i go ba de yong gi yong gi red/ mchod pa mi 'bul ba de chos la dad pa ched pa'i rtags zer mkhan gcig yang 'dug de thugs dag pa yin pa red/ de 'dra ba yi dad pa ma byas nas dngos su 'jal rgyu byung na go chod pa'i ca lag 'dra bo dang / dngos su mjal rgyu ma byung na ca lag thabs chag thabs chag 'dra bo ma gtogs mi 'bul mkhan des gang byas dad pa ma byung ba red/gsum pa sdig pa bshags pa'i yan laga'adod chags zhe sdang gti mug dbang gis ni/ /lus dang ngag dang de bzhin yid kyis kyang / /sdig pa bdag gis bgyis pa ci mchis pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis so sor bshags/ /bshags pa zhes pa'i don dag de sdig pa byas pa la 'gyod pa byas/ da phroṃn chad mi byed snyams pa'i bsam blo la bshags pa zer/ mazol zhing bshags zer na/ dngos su kha dang lag pas ngas nyes pa de 'dra zhig byas song zhes bshad pa mazol ba/ da phyin chad ngas rtsab nas byed kyi min bsam pa bshags pa/ de gnyis ka la phan yon so sor yod red/ mthol bzhag pa yin na de sngon srung bya byas pa'i nyes pa de tsho yang bkag la/ ma bshad pa yin na nyes pa de nyi ma re re bzhin du nyung mtha' nyis ldab 'phel 'gro yi yod red zer/ ming gi sgo nas sgos nas ngas nyes pa 'di 'dra'i zhig byas song

bzang spyod 'grel ba/ 19zhes bshad ma thub na yang / spyor stangs ngas nyes pa byas song zhes bshad pa yin na 'phel kha bkag 'gro ba yin dus gnad gal che po red/ bshags pa byas pa des sdig pa rnams dag 'gro yi yod red/ dag zhes pa sdeg pa'i sa sas maid pa byed 'gro ba ma red de/ des 'bras bu sdug bsngal skye mi thub pa zhig bzo 'gro ba red/ so so la sdig pa med bsam rgyu yod ma red/ so soda'i sems kyis dmyal ba mnar me+ed du 'gro ba'i sdig pa tshad med pa zhig byed bzhin yod red/ dper na dmyal ba la skye ba'i rgyu de zhe sdang red/ zhe sdang gis kun nas slangs te mi gcig la tshig ngan pa zhig lab de 'grig song bsam nas rjes su yi rang byas na/ dmyal ba la skye ba'i sbyor dngos rjes gsum cha tshang zhig tshang tshar ba red/ de dang de 'dra ba'i sdig pa nyi ma re re bzhin du dal khom med pa bsags bzhin yod red/ de yin dus sdig pa che po yod bsam dgos kyi yod red/ de ljon yang dmyal ba mnar med pa na len grangs tshad med pa skyes yod red/ da dung yang tshad med pa zhig gi skye ba'i sdig pa sems kyi thog la bzhag yod red/ kun slong 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug gi dbang gis te/ dper na 'dod chags kyi sgo nas srog bcad pa sha la dga' ba'i sgo nas srog bcad pa lta bu/ zhe sdang gi sgo nas dgra so bsad pa lta bu/ sa/ti mug sgo nas bsad pa kha gcig gis srog bcad na chos su brtsinas sgog bcad pa lta bu/ mdor na mi dge zer ba de ga 'dra byas nas ngos 'dzin dgos zhe na/ kun slong 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum gyis byas pa'i de tsho la mi dge ba zer/ sbyongar ba lus kyi sgo nas srog bcad pa/ ngag gi sgo nas brdzun bshad pa/ de bzhin yid kyi sgo nas

20 mkhan chen a pad rin po che/kyang gnod sems byas pa lta bu/ bdag gis bkyis pa ci mchis pa zhes pa na yod tshad med tshad thams cad bshags pa byed kyi yin gsungs pa red/sus bshags na bdag gis bshags/ so sor zer na saṃkrita'i skad du pazi zer gyi yod red/ de so so la yang go dang sa la yang go rab la yang go yi yod red/ so so ste nyes pa de tsho sde tshan ma rjas pa so sor ngos bzung nas re re bzhin du bshags kyi yin zer ba'i don dag red/ bshags pa des sdig pa thams cad 'dag thub pa'i phan yon che po yod red/bzhi pa rjes su yi rang ba'i yan lagaphyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun dang sangs rgyas sras/ /rang rgyal rnams dang slob dang mislob dang / /'gro ba kun gyi bsod nams gang la yang / /de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag yi rangs/ /rjes su yi rang zer ba dge ba de la dga' so byed pa/ de'ang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bsod nams la dga' sa byed/ sangs rgyas kyi sras zer na byang chub sems dpa' red/ byang chub sems dpa'i rgyud la yang bsod nams tshad me+ed pa yod red de tsho la yang dga' bo byed kyi yin/ rang rgyal zer na 'phags pa'i gang zag gcig red/ sangs rgyas snga ma'i bstan pa rdzogs tshar bye ma'i bstan pa ma phebs bar du rang rgyal mang po byon pa red de tsho rnams dang / slob pa dang mi slob pa zer na nyan zos red/ de la slob pa dang mi slob gnyis bshad yod red/ slob pa la rgyun zhugs/ phyir 'ong / phyir mi 'ong gsum/ mi slob pa zer na dgra bcom pa de tsho'i dge rtsathams cad

bzang sgod 'grel ba/ 21dang / des 'phags pa'i gang zag bzhi bstan pa red/ 'gro ba zer na 'dod chags dang bcas pa'i sgo nas 'khor ba'i gnas su 'gro ba la zer/ kun zer na 'phags pa'i gang zag bzhi sto ma yin pa'i 'gro ba kun/ 'gro ba kun gyi bsod nams te dge ba red gang la yang de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag gis yi rang byed kyi yin gsungs pa red/ yi rang zer na phrag dog me+ed par dga' bo byed kyi yin gsungs pa red/ yid dang zer na yi ge ma dag pa red/ nged tsho'i rang gzhan gyi nyon mongs pa de tshos gzhan gyis dge ba sgrub na/ mi de skyed so byung na/ de la phun sum tshogs pa byung na/ de bstod pa byung na ma dga' ba chags gi yod red/ rjes su yi rang zer dus gzhan gyis dge ba bsags zin pa'i rjes su sems phrag dog med par dga' sa byed pa la zer/ de phan yon che sa red/ stong gsum 'di dag srang la bzhal nas tshad bzung yang / /rjes su yi rang dge ba de ni de ltar min/ /zhes gsungs pa ste stong gsum gyi ri rab kyi sa yi rdul phran de tsho srang la bzhal na ste lcid tshad de srang la bzhal thub yang / rjes su yi rang kyi dge ba'i bsod nams de tshad 'dzin thub kyi ma red gsungs/ bsod nams che so bsag gi red mdo gcig gi nang du gsungs 'dug de thabs la mkhas pa'i dge rtsab zer ba de yin gsungs/ dper na mi gcig gis dge ba byas pa thams cad la dga' so byed 'dug dgos red/ de goms dgos red goms sdad pa yin na nyi ma re re bzhin du yag nas yag du 'gro yi red/ de so sos las ka byed mi dgos pa mi yis dge ba byas pa'i bsod nams de mnyam por thob yong gi yod tsang / thabs la mkhas pa'i dge rtsagasungs/ byang chub sems bskyed

22 mkhan chen a pad rin po che/byas des nas rjes su yi rang yag po byas pa yin na/ dge ba byed mkhan de bas kyang lhag pa'i bsod nams thob kyi yod red/ sangs rgyas kyi dge rtsal rjes su yi rang byas pa yin na sangs rgyas kyi dge rtsalas che ba thob kyi red zhes bshad thub kyi yod ma red de/ sbyir stangs dge rtsade las che ba zhig thob srid kyi yod pa red/lnga pa chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba bsgul ba'i yan lagagang rnams phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten sgon rnams/ /byang chub rim par sangs rgyas ma chags brnyes/ /mabo na po de dag bdag gi thams cad la/ /'khor lo bla na med pa bskor bar bsgul/ /chos gsungs rogs gyis zhes zhu gi yod red/ gang rnams zhes pa de spyi sgra su la bshad na yang 'grig mkhan/ rnams mang po red/ ga 'dra byas bshad dgos red zhe na/ gang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi sgon ma rnams te sangs rgyas rnams zhes sbyar nas 'grel ba rgyag dgos red/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i 'jig rten zer na sems can red/ sems can gyi sgon ma/sgon ma zer na mun pa sel mkhan red sangs rgyas zer ba de mar me dang 'dra bo red/ ma rig pa'i mun pa sel mkhan yin tsang phyogs bcu'i 'dzig rten gyi sgon me/ gang na su bzhugs pa thams cad/ byang chub rim par zer na/ byang chub zer na sangs rgyas red/ rim par zer na lam rim pa bzhin du bgrod de sangs rgyas pas na byang chub rim pa/ ma chags brnyes zer na dngosaso thams cad la chags 'dzin ped pa'i go 'pha nga brnyes pa'i sangs

bzang sgod 'grel ba/ 23rgyas de rnams/ che sa dbyengs su mnyam bzhag mdzad nas rtag par bzhugs mdzad rgyu yod ma red gsungs pa red/ sangs rgyas kha shas kyis chos sku brnyes ye nga dus/ chos dbyings la mnyam bzhag mdzad nas bzhugs 'dug mkhan chos bshad pa mi sgo ba yod red de rnams la 'di zhu ba yin zer/mgodan po dag thams cad la/ zhu mkhan su yes zhu ba ye mdza zer na bdag gis bla na med pa'i tsho sa kyi 'kho ra lo bskosnar ba bsgul te brgyud bsgul zhu ba yin gsungs/ sangs rgyas chesas gsungs ba 1 1mkhan rnams la zhu mi dbo sa pas/ chedas gsungs par mi spro mkhan sangs rgyas de dag la che sa gsungs rogs gyis zhes zhu ba 'bul gyi yodad gsungs pa red/ de la phan yon che po yod gsungs pa red/ de phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad la zhu yi bsam na/ de phyin chad sangs rgyas kyis chos kyi 'khor lo gang bskor ba'i phan yon de thams cad thob kyi yod gsungs pa red/drug pa mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba 'debs pa'i yan lag yang sangs rgyas kha shas mi bzhugs nas dgongs pa rdzogs grab byed kyi yod red/ de dag la ma 'das par bzhugs rogs zhu kyi yod red/ de'ang nged tshos dus rgyun bla ma 'dra bo la chos gsungs rogs zhes zhus na yang phan yon bsam kyi khyab pa yod red/ de bzhin du bla ma sgu tshe zhabs pad brtan pa'i ched du gsol ba btabs pa la yang de dang mtshwangs pa'i phan yon yod red /mya ngan 'da' ston gang bzhed de dag la/ /'gro ba kun pre phan zhing bde ba'i phyir/ /

24 mkhan chen a pad rin po che/bskal ba zhing gi rdul snyed bzhugs par yang / /bdag gis thal mo rab sbyar gsol bar bgyi/ /sbyir stangs mya ngan zer na zag bcas las nyon gyis bsdus pa'i phung po de tsho la zer gyi red/ 'da' zer na shi zhes pa'i don dag red/ mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul ston pa gang bzhed pa'i sangs rgyas de dag la/mya ngan las mi 'da' ba'i re ba 'di zhu yi yod gsungs/ dgos pa ga re don du zhe na/ 'gro ba kun la mthar thug phan zhing gnas skabs bde ba zob pa'i phyir du/ dus yun ring thung ji tsam bzhugs dgos red zhe na/ bskal ba'i bar du ste zhe drag yun ring sto red/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams zer na sgod rgya che so red/ de'i rdul phran gyi grangs ka ji snyed yod pa de snyed kyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i bskal pa la bzhugs rogs mdzod zhes bdag gi lag pas thal mo sbyar nas gsodal ba ste zhu ba 'bul gyi yod gsungs/ des sangs rgyas la mya ngan las mi 'da' bar 'jig rten la yun ring bzhugs rogs mdzod zhes zhu ba phul ba red/ de zhus nas mya ngan las ma 'das par sems can gyi don mdzad nas bzhugs pa'i dge rtsathams cad rang la thob kyi red gsungs/ de yis yan lag drug phyin pa red/ yag lag bdun po des bsags sbyangs spel gsum zer dus/ de'ang dge rtsabasags sdig pa sbyang dge rtsagong 'phel du gtong ba gsum la zhe drag gnad gal che sa red/ chos zer ba de rang gis byed nus na ma shes pa yod ma red gsungs kyi 'dug yan lag bdun so shes na de nas nyams len byas sdad na 'grig gi yod red/ des nang nas phyag 'tshal/mchod pa/ chos 'khor bskor bar bsgul/ mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol

bzang spyod 'grel ba/ 25ba 'debs pa bzhi po de dge rtsabasags zer ba de red/ bshags pa de sdig pa sgongs ba'i don dag red/ rjes su yi rang ba des dge rtsasrel 'gro yi yod red/ so so'i dge rtsabasags pa la de yag po zhe drag byung skal ba bzang sa red bsam nas rjes su yi rangs byed dgos red/ yin na yang de nga rgyal dang ma 'dres par byed dgosas/ de ngas byed thub gzhan dag gis ma byas pas nga yag so red 'dug bsam na de nga rgyal yin pas skyon red/ de nas baljo ba zer rgyu des kyang dge rtsasrel 'gro yi yod red/ des na gnyis po des spel/ bzhi yis bsags/ gcig gis sbyang ba ste bsags sbyang spel gsum byed mkhan yin dus yan lag bdun po 'a gnad che po red/ sngags kyi cho ga phal che ba yan lag bdun pas bcings bzhag yodad pa red/ de bsngo rgyu'i dge rtsabasags pa red/gnyis pa yan lag mtha' ma'i sgo nas bsags pa'i dge ba gzhan do/na du bsngo ba/ de la yang de la yan lag drug gis bsags pa'i dge rtsabaljo ba dang / mdo bton pas bsags pa'i dge rtsabaljo ba dang gnyis yod red/ dang sto yan lag drug gis bsags pa'i dge rtsabagro ba la yang / mdor bsdu par bsdo ba/ rgyas par baljo ba/ don bsdus pas bsngo dang gsum/ dang so ni/phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang / /rjes su yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba 'debs/ /dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa/ /thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub phyir bsngo'o/ /snga ma de dag slar yang gsungs mdzad pa red/ phyag 'tshal ba'i dge sga

26 mkhan chen a pad rin po che/mchod pa phral ba'i dge rtsa/bshags pa byas pa'i dge sgachos 'khor bskor bar bskul ba'i dge spa mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba'i dge spa rjes su yi rangs byas pa yi dge ba'i rtsab cung zad de chung mtha' nas bdag gis ci bsags pa de dag thams cad kyis 'bras bu gzhan zob par ma gyur bar/bdag gis rdzogs pa'i byang chub phyir bsngo ba ste bdag gis rjes ma sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i phyir baljo ba byed kyi yin gsungs/ de mdor bsdus pa zer ba de red/ baljo ba byas bzhag pa yin na dge rtsade yis 'bras bu smin thub mkhan gyi dge rtsade yag tu 'gro ba red/ byas tsang srel bar byed pa'i thabs gnad gal che sa yin pa red/ 'apri gung skyobs pas gsungs pa red/ tshogs gnyis yid bzhin nor bu la/ /baljo ba bzang sas ma khyab na//dgos 'dod kyi 'bras bu mi 'byung bas/ /'jug baljo ba 'di la nan gtan mdzod gsungs pa red/gnyis pa baljo ba rgyas par bshad pa la bcu drug las dang sa/1 lhag bsam dag pa'i sgon lam/ 2byang chub kyi sems mi bajed pa'i sgon lam/ 3nyes pas ma gos pa 'khor bar skye ba'i sgon lam/ 4sems can la phan pa dang bde ba'i sgon lam/ 5go cha dang 'brel ba'i smon lam/ 6skal mnyam gyi grogs po dag dang 'phrad pa'i smon lam/ 7dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten cing mnyes par byed pa'i smon lam/ 8sangs rgyas kyi zhal la blta ba'i smon lam ni/ 9dam chos 'dzin pa'i sgon lam ni/ 10 yon tan gyi mdzod zob pa'i smon lam/ 11'jug pa du ma'i sgo nas zhing sgongs ba'i smon lam/12stobs bsam gyi mi khyab pa zob pa'i sgon lam/ 13spang bya zad pa'i ye

bzang sgod 'grel ba/ 27shes chen po rob pa'i sgon lam/ 14'gre las sna tshogs byed thub pa'i sgon lam/ 15sangs rgyas dang byang sems kyi rjes su slob pa'i sgon lam/ 16thams cad kyi don bsdu ba'i smosan lam/ (dpal phyogs kyi glang sa la sogs pa ljon gyi mkhan pa rnams kyis don tshan bcu rnam pa bcu drug tu mdzad pa do/de yang sdom ni/lhag bsam byang sems mi brjed dang / /ma gos phan bde go cha dang / /skal mnyam grogs dang bshes gnyen bsten/ /sangs rgyas mngon gyur dam chos 'dzin/ /mi zad mdzod zob 'jug pa dang / /stobs dang bsgrub pa las dang ni/ /rjes su slob dang 'dug sdud do//)dang sa la/ sangs rgyas la mchod pa'i sgon lam/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye nga ba smosan lam/ sems can la phan bde 'grub pa'i smosan lam/ gsum las dang po ni/ spyir bzang sgod 'di la/ rgya bod gyi bstan 'gyur gyi nang la 'grel ba lnga yod red/ klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ phyogs kyi glang sas mdzad pa/ rgyan bzang sas mdzad pa/ shākya bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ shākya bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa de rgyas shesas red/ de tsho'i nang du don tshan bcu drug la tsho bgos byas yod red/ de 'ang don tshan dang sto lhag bsam dang ldan pa'i sgon lam zhes pa de red/'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang phyogs bcu yi/ /'jig rten dag na gang bzhugs mchod par bgyi/ /gang yang ma byon de dag rab myur bar/ /bsam rdzogs byang chub rim par sangs rgyas sbyo na/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams zer na 'od srung lta bu mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan zin pa de dag red/ da lta'i sangs rgyas zer na da lta phyogs

28 mkhan chen a pad rin po che/bcu'i 'dzig rten gyi khams bde ba can na 'od dpag ched lta bu/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten dag na da lta gang bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas de rnams la rang gzhan gyi don du mchod pa 'bul bar gyur cig gsungs pa red/ byang chub sems dpa' gang yang ma byon zer na ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas/ de ljon sangs rgyas kyi go sa na ma byon pa ma 'ongs pa na sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'gro rgyu yin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de dag rab myur te mgyogs sor byas nas/ bsam rdzogs te tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs nas byang chub rim par te lam gyi rim pa bzhin du byang chub nas sangs rgyas kyi sa la/ byedan zer na byon cing / ma 'ongs sangs rgyas thams cad da lta byang chub sems dpa' red/ ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas de tsho da lta byang chub sems dpa'i sa nas margyasags so byas nas sangs rgyas kyi sa la phebs rogs gnongs zhus pa red/ de lhag bsam dag pa'i sgon lam red/gnyis pa zhing sgongs ba ni/ spyir stangs byang chub sems pa la rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum zhes gnad che sto zhig bshad rgyu yod red/ rdzogs zer na sgon lam rdzogs pa/ sems can smin zer na ma 'ongs par rang nyid sangs rgyas 'gro dus da lta nas gra bsgrigs byed dgos kyi yod red/ sangs rgyas chos gsungs dus sprul pa'i sgu nang bzhin gyis chos gsungs dus 'khor de na 'phags pa'i lam thob la khad pa zhig bzo dgos kyi yod red/ de la sems can smin zer na da lta nas 'phags lam zob chog chog byas pa/ zhing bh+yong ba zer na ma 'ongs pa sangs rgyas 'gro dus sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams yag po rgya che po bde ba can zhing tso so zhig zob dgos kyi yod red/ de da lta nas

bzang sgod 'grel ba/ 29bzo dgos kyi yod red de la zhing bh+yong ba zer/ zhing lhong ba'i nyams len ngo ma de nga tsho'i sher phyin nang du gsungs pa'i sa brgyad pa yan chad la skye yi yod red de/ da lta nas smon lam btabs pa nas zhing sgong dgos/ byas tsang rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum zhes gnad che so de bzang spyod kyi smon lam 'di nang du phal che ba de gsum yin pa red/ de'i nang nas da lta 'di sems can smin pa zer ba de'i smon lam bshad pa red/spyong ba'i sgon lam la/ sgod sbyangs ba dang / bcud sbyangs ba gnyis/ dang sto ni/ phyogs bcu'i ga la'i zhing rnams ji snyed pa/ /de dag rgya chen yongs su dag par 'gyur/ /phyogs bcu'i ga la ba ste gang yang rung ba'i mang tshig 'dra bo red/ gang yang rung ba'i zhing khams ji snyed yod pa de dag chung chung ma yin pa'i rgya che ba/ yongs su dag pa ste sgod kyi 'jig rten de dag tsher ma dang rdo dang 'bar 'bur la sodags pa'i skyon med mkhan/ bcud kyi sems can de tsho la nyon mongs pa shugs drag pos mi dge ba spyodad mkhan ma yin pa/ des gtso bo sgod bshad pa red yongs su dag par gyur cing gsungs/ mdor na phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di bde ba can gyi zhing khams lta bu rgya che la yo ngas su dag pa can zhig tu gyur cig gnyis pa bcud sbyodangs ba ni/byang chub shing dbang drung gshegs rgyal ba dang / /sangs rgyas sras kyis rab tu gang bar shegag /byang chub kyi shing zer na rdo rje gdan gyi shing lta bu/ shing de'i drung du sangs rgyas dang byang sems kyis gang sdad yodad pa shogag gsungs pa red/ gshegs

30 mkhan chen a pad rin po che/shing byon pa'i rgyal ba rnams dang sangs rgyas kyi sras byang chub sems dpa'/ mdor na sems can tha mal ba d+mad pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems kyis yongs su gang bar shog gsungs pa red/gsum pa sems can rnams la phan bde'i smosan lam/phyogs bcu'i sems can gang rnams ji sted pa/ /de dag rtag tu nad med bde bar gyur/ /'asgo ba kun gyi chos kyi don rnams ni/ /mthun par gyur cing re ba'ang 'grub par shog /phyogs bcu na yod pa'i sems can gang dag yod pa de dag thams cad dus rtag tu lus dang sems la nad med pa dang / gnas skabs kun du bde bar gyur cig zhes bde ba'i sgon lam dang / mthar thug phan pa'i sgon lam ni 'gro ba kun gyi chos kyi don rnams ni mthun par gyur cing te chos byed pa la phan tshun blo mthun par gyur cig gsungs pa red/ de nas chos dang mthun pa'i re ba sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang zob par gyur cig sems can thams cad kyis chos byed pa de sangs rgyas la re ba byed kyi yod red de 'grub par gyur cig zhes de 'dra'i go bde lha byas na yang 'grig gi yod red/ chos kyi don rnams la mthun par gyur zer ba la zhib cha byas na/ chos kyi don rnams so so'i rja dang mthun zhes pa ni/ 1 chos dang mthun zhes pa dang don dag gcig pa red/ chos bsgrub pa'i re ba chos sgrub pa la phan yon zhig mazong nas bsgrub kyi yod red/ de'i phan yon thams cad 'grub par gyur cig gsungs/ de yan chad lhag bsam dang ldan pa'i sgon lam zer ba de red/

bzang sgod 'grel ba/ 31gnyis pa byang chub kyi sems mi brjed pa'i sgon lam/ de la mthun rkyen tshang ba'i sgon lam/ 'gal rkyen sgong ba'i sgon lam gnyis las/ dang so/ rtag tu rab tu 'byung bar sgon pa/ tshul khrims rnam dag la spyod par sgon pa/ sna tshogs skad kyis chos ston par smon pa/ des shing dul ba'i sgo nas dge bar brtse pa'i sgon pa/ bzhi las dang sa ni/byang chub kyi sems de garnad gal che po red de maid na sangs rgyas kyi yon tan mtha' dag yod ma red/ de skye ba 'di la mang po sbyangs pa yin na skye ba phyi ma phan chad la yag po yong gi yod yin pa red/ skye ba grangs maid mang po la de goms par byas nas mi bajed pa de gnad che po red/byang chub sgod pa dag ni bdag spyod cing / /'gro ba kun tu skye ba dran par 'gyur/ /tshe rabs kun tu 'chi 'pho skye ba mā/ /rtag tu bdag ni rab tu 'byung bar shogag /byang chub kyi sems ma brjed pa'i thog nas/ byang chub kyi sems mi brjed pa'i rgyu bzhi dang 'gal rkyen rnams sgong ba'i sgon lam red/ byang chub sgod pa zer na/ byen pa gtong / tshul khrims srung / bzod pa bsgom pa de tsho red/de tsho la bdag gis spyod cing de dag thams cad/ dang po 'gro ba kun tu zer ba de bshad/ de nas byang chub spyod pa dag ni bdag spyod cing skye ba dran par 'gyur zhes de 'dra bshad na/ skye ba kun tu zer na skye ba phyi ma 'gro ba rigs lnga po gang du skyes kyang / 'gro ba kun tu byang chub kyi spyodad pa spyodad cing skye ba snga ma dran par 'gyur zhing / skye ba snga ma dran na yang sems bskyed skye yong gi yod

32 mkhan chen a pad rin po che/red/ skye ba snga ma dran mkhan mang sto yod red/ dper na rgyal so kun sgod la sogs pa lta bu/ tshe rabs kun tu 'chi 'pho skye ba na zer na/ skye ba blangs pa nas 'chi 'phos ba'i bar du zhes de 'dra'i 'grel ba rgyab na yang 'grig gi red/ yang na lung pa kha shas nas mar 'chi lung pa kha shas na yar skye ba len gyi yod red de'i gnas skabs na/ len re tsam ma yin pa dus rtag tu bdag ni rab tu 'byung par shogag cig gsungs/gnyis pa tshul khrims rnam dag la byedad pa'i smon pa/ skye ba bajes te lus sor ba de sems bskyed mi byed pa'i rgyu gcig red/ yang sems bskyed mi byed pa'i rgyu gnyis pa sgong ba'i smon lam/rgyal ba kun gyi rjes su slob gyur te/ / bzang so sgod pa yongs su rdzogs byed cing / /tshul khrims spyod pa dri med yongs dag pa/ /rtag tu ma nyams skyon me+ed spyod par shog /rgyal ba kun gyi rjes su slob zer na sangs rgyas kyis ga re byas pa'i rjes su 'brang ba/ bzang sa sbyod pa zer na byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa'am byang chub kyi sems kyis kun nas slangs ba'i sgod pa yongs su rdzogs par spyod cing /de byas na de'ang sems bskyed mi nyams pa'i rgyu yin pa red/ bzang sa sgod pa zer na spyir stangs pha rol du phyin pa drug de'i nang nas khyad par du tshul khrims kyi sgod pa sgod cing gsungs pa red/ tshul khrims ga 'dra zhig sgod zhe na/ tshul khrims khyad par bzhi lngan zer/dri ma med pa/ yongs su dag pa/ rtag tu ma nyams/ skyon ched pa bzhi red/ dri ma med pa zer na nyon mongs pa med

bzang spyod 'grel ba/ 33pa/ dper na tshe 'di la dmigs nas tshul khrims srung pa yin na de dri ma dang bcas pa red/ de sar bzhag dgos red/ 'azom ston pas gsungs pa nang bzhin/ ngas sgoms byed ga zhus dus/ 'o nga las ka ngan pa de g.yug bzhag dgos red gsungs pa red/ ngas khyag 'tshal lam zhus pas de yang las ka thabs chag red/ 'o na ga re byed dgos zhus dus tshe 'di blos sangs ba zhig byed dgos red gsungs pa red/ byas tsang rje btsun grags pas kyang tshe 'di la dmigs pa'i tshul khrims sodags g.yug shegag gsungs pa red/ de 'dra yi tshul khrims de dri ma dang bcas pa red/ de 'dra ba'i dri ma sped pa/ yongs su dag pa zer na rang don du theg dman kyi thar pa thob dgos kyi bsam nas de'i ched srung ba'i tshul khrims de ma dag pa red de 'dra ma yin pa'i dag pa/ ma nyams pa zer na tshul khrims de la pham pa bzhi lta bus lus ngag gi sgod pas ma nyams pa/ skyon sped pa zer na rnam smin gyi 'bras bu skye ba phyi ma mazo ris kyi go 'phang zob dgos bsam na skyon dang bcas pa red de 'dra yi skyon med pa/ de 'dra yi khyad par bzhi ldan gyi tshul khrims spyod par shegag cig gsungs/gsum pa sna tshogs skad kyis chos bston par smon pa/ byang chub kyi sems mi brjed pa'i rgyu gsum pa skye ba phyi ma rnams su che sa ston thub pa'i smon lam/lha yi skad dang klu dang gnod sbyin skad/ /grul bum dag dang mi yi skad rnams kyis/ /'gro ba kun gyi sgra rnams ji tsam pa/ /

34 mkhan chen a pad rin po che/thams cad skad du bdag gis chos ston to/ /da lta skad gcig gcig pu'i don rgya che po byed thub yod ma red/ de yin dus skad mang yo shes dgos kyi yod red/ de'ang lha yi skad/ klu yi skad/ gnod sbyin skad/ grul bum dag gi skad/ mi yi skad rnams dang / dang sgras nga tsho'i skad rigs gzhan dag rnams bsdu ba'i don du red/ mdor na 'gro ba kun gyi sgra rnams ji tsam yodad pa'i sems can thams cad kyi skad du bdag gis skye ba dang tshe rabs thams cad du chos ston to/bzhi pa des shing dul ba'i sgo nas dge bar bcod pa'i sgon pa/ byang chub kyi sems mi brjed pa'i rgyu dul ba'i smosan lam ni/des shing pha rol phyin la rab brtse te/ /byang chub sems ni nam yang brjed ma gyur/ /sems bskyed mi nyams pa'i rgyu bzhi pa des shing te lus ngag yid gsum sogs sems rgyud dul sto/ pha rol du phyin pa la rab tu brtse pa ste/ phar phyin te sbyin pa/ tshul khrims/ bzod pa/ brtse 'grus/ bsam gtan/ shes rab de tsho la zer gyi yod red/ rab tu brtson pa zer na spyo ba yod pa dang dze+en pa gtong dgos/ tshul khrims srung dgos zhes rtag par goms dgos kyi red/ pha rol tu phyin pa la rab tu brtse te dmigs yul byang chub kyi sems nam yang brjed par ma gyur cigaganyis pa byang chub kyi sems mi dran pa'i rgyu 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib sbyongangs ba'i sgon lam/ nga tsho la byang chub kyi sems tshe rabs rjes ma la mi dran ba'i rgyu 'gal rkyen gyi sgrib pa yod red/ de tsho byang ba'i sgon lam/

bzang sgod 'grel ba/ 35sdig pa gang rnams sgrib par gyur pa dag /de dag ma lus yongs su byang bar shogag /dper na nag po'i tsho sa bzhi zer mkhan 'dra sto byang chub sems dpa'i rtsaba'i ltung ba lta bu sdig pa gang dag rnams/de dag gi byed las ga re red zhe na sgrib par gyur pa ste/ sdig pa sems rgyud la yodad tshar dus byang chub kyi sems skye ba la sgrib pa byed kyi yod red/ dper na da lta nga tsho la rgyu mtshan phyogs re la che sa gcig byed dgo sa 'dug bsam pa yodad na yang / sems des byed rogs byed kyi yod ma red de sgrib pa shas che sa yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis red/ sgrib pa ped song na sems de rang shugs kyis chos su 'gro yi yod red/ byas tsang sgrib sgong de gnad che po red/ chos slob spyong byas na yang yag po mi shes pa de sgrib pas byas pa red/ de dag ma lus yodangs su byang bar shogag zhes de don tshan gnyin pa red byang chub kyi sems mi brjed ba'i ste na lam/gsum pa nyes pas ma go sa pa 'khor bar skye ba'i smosan lam/ don tshan gsum pa 'khor ba'i nyes pas ma gosas par 'khor ba na skye ba len thub pa'i sgon lam ni/ dper na nged tsho 'khor ba na skye yong dus las dang nyon mongs pa'i gzhan dbang gis skye yong gi yod red/ nyon mongs pa'i gzhan dbang gis sdug bsngal bzhin sdad yod red/ rang dbang yod ma red las dang nyon mongs pas 'ching 'gro yi yod red/ byang sems 'phags pa zer rgyu des las nyon spang tshar/ 'khor ba na skye ba bzhes rgyu de bsam bzhin du sems can gyi don du snyi jes dbang gis gzhan don du skye ba bzhes kyi yod red/ de

36 mkhan chen a pad rin po che/'dra byed thub pa'i sgon lam dang snying rjes sgo nas skye ba len dgos kyi red gsungs pa red/ de'i sgon lam de 'di tsho lta bu red/las dang nyon mongs bdud kyi las rnams las/ /grol zhing 'jig rten grol ba rnams su yang / /ji ltar pad+mo chus mi chags pa bzhin/ /nyi zla nam mkhar thogs pa sped ltar spyad/ /zag bcas kyi las dge ba dang mi dge de tsho sgong ba/ 'dod chags la se gas pa nyon mongs pa de tsho sgong ba dang / bdud kyi las te/ nged tshos sdig pa ma bsags na yang bdud de tshos ngan song du 'khrid 'gro ba zhig yod sa red/spyod 'jug nang du/ de yang ngan song gnas gtong phyir/ /bdud rnams kyis ni brtsod par byed/ /gsungs pas bdud rnams kyis sems can ngan mo nga du 'khrid 'gro yi yodad sa red/ de 'dra'i gsum sa las grol zhing byang chub sems dpa' las dang /nyon mongs pa dang / bdud kyi las rnams las grol tshar ba red/lha la sonags pa'i 'jig rten gyi 'gro ba lnga sa rnams su yang las nyon dang bdud kyis khrid song ba ma yin pa steng jes dbang gis 'khor ba na skye ba len dgos gsungs pa red/ 'khor ba na skye ba len dus dpe ji ltar na ste tog pad+mo la chu dgos kyi yod red/ chu nang du skyes kyang chus mi chags pa red/ dpe de bzhin du 'khor ba na skyes kyang 'khor ba'i nyes pas ma gos pa zhig la zer ba red/ de ma zad nyi ma dang zla ba zer ba de tsho nam mkha' la su gang gis kyang bka' 'go ga med pa thogs pa med par 'gro nas sems can gyi don mang sa byed kyi yod red/ de bzhin du sbyad de 'khor ba na skye ba blang te

bzang sgod 'grel ba/ 37sems can gyi don mang sa byed par shogag gsungs pa red/bzhi pa sems can la phan dang bde ba'i smosan lam ni/zhing gi khyon dang phyogs rnams ji tsam pa/ /ngan song sdug bsngal rab tu zhi bar byed/ /bde ba dag la 'gro ba kun 'god cing / /'gro ba thams cad la ni phan par spyad/ /sangs rgyas zhing khams kyi khye na zer na bye gas bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams dang / phyogs rnams te 'jig rten khams kyi ji tsam pa/ mdor na 'jig rten khams kyi rgya khyon ji tsam yod pa de tsam gyi ngan song gis sdug bsngal rab tu zhi bar byed/ gnas skabs mtho ris kyi bde ba dag la 'gro ba kun 'go da cing / mthar thug pa'i 'gro ba thams cad la ni dam pa'i che sa kyi sgo nas phan thog pa la longs spyod par sho ga cig gsungs/ bde ba dang phan pa zer ba ni/gnas skabs bde ba/ mthar thug phan pa mngon 'gyur du de 'dra skye bar shogag cig gsungs pa red/lnga pa go cha dang 'brel ba'i sgon lam lam/ ma 'ongs pa na thob par shesag zhes go cha che po bgos nas dam bca' byed kyi yod red/byang chub sgod pa yongs su rdzogs byed cing / /sems can dag gis sgod dang mthun par 'jug /bzang so sbyod pa dag ni rab nyon cing / /ma 'ongs bskal pa kun tu sbyod par gyur/ /byang chub spyodad pa zer na ma 'ongs pa na byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis

38 mkhan chen a pad rin po che/sbyod pa yongs su rdzogs par byed cing / sems can gzhan dag gi lus ngag gi spyod pa dang mthun par 'jug te de dag dang mthun pa'i lus ngag gi spyod pa sbyad zhes pa'i don dag red/ dper na bdag cag gi ston pas/ rang don du dgos pa yod ma red de rgyal srid bzung ba dang / btsun mo bzhes pa dang / mngal nas skyes pa la sogs pa 'jig rten gyi byedad pa dang mthun pa yin gsungs pa red/ 'jig rten gyi sgod pa dang mthun pa bstan na de dag zhugs pa'i dgos pa yod gsungs pa red/ bzang po spyod pa zer na byang chub sems dpa'i bye da pa red/ sems can gzhan la rab tu ston zer ba chos bshad/las ka de gsum ma 'ongs pa'i bskal pa kun tu ste thams cad du de gsum sgod thub par gyur cig 'di nang du mtshams mtshams la byang chub spyod pa/mtshams mtshams la bzang sto spyodad pa de gnyis gcig par go san 'grig gi yod yin pa red/ don du byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sgod pa spyad pa red/ de gnyis so sor phyes na 'grel ba rgyag rgyu yod yin pa red/ byang chub kyi spyod pa zer ba ye shes kyi tshogs red/ bzang sa sgod pa zer ba bsod nams kyi tshogs sbyon pa gtong ba la sogs pa de dag red gsungs pa red/spyir stangs byang chub sems dpa' la gnyis yod red gsungs/ 'dod chen pa dang de ma yin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' zer ba gnyis/ de'ang rgyal sa lta bu 'dod che ba'i sems bskyed dang / rdzi sto lta bu dpe d+mad pa'i sems bskyed gnyis yod gsungs pa dang don dag gcig pa 'dra sa red/'dod chen pa zer ba de dang sto so so sangs rgyas de nas sems can gyi don byed dgos 'dug bsam nas sems bskyed byas sgon lam rgyag mkhan gcig yodad red/ de

bzang spyod 'grel ba/ 39yis gtso so stong pa nyid sgom gyi yod red/ de myur du sangs rgyas dgos kyi yod pa yin stabs/ ye shes kyi tshogs zer rgyu de 'dod chen gyi spyodad pa red/de la'ang byang chub sbyod pa zer gyi yod red/ de ma yin pa zer rgyu des/ dang sa sangs rgyas rgyu mi 'dug sems can rnams 'khor ba las gro la dgo/sa kyi 'dug mo so dbyang chub spyodad pa spyad nas/ byang chub kyi sems stobs sto che la gnas bzhin du sems can rnams 'khor ba las sgo la dgo/sa 'dug bsam pa de blo stobs che sa red/ de yis myur du sangs rgyas pa'i don dag la lta ba gtso lhar sgom gyi med pa red/ dang so sems can gyi don byed chos bshad sbyon pa bsod nams kyi tshogs bsogs kyi yod red/ de la 'dod chen pa dang ma yin pa'i sgod pa kun tu bzang sa sbyod pa zer gyi yod red/ byas tsang byang chub kyi spyod pa zer na ye shes kyi tshogs 'dod chen pa'i spyod pa/ bzang sa sgod pa zer na bsod nams kyi tshogs 'dod chen ma yin pa'i spyod pa de dag la sbyod par gyur gsungs/drug pa skal mnyam gyi grogs sto dag dang 'phrad pa'i sgon lam/bdag gis spyodad dang mtshungs par gang byedad pa/ /de dag dang ni rtag tu 'grogs par sho ga /lus dang ngag rnams dang ni sems kyis kyang / /spyodad pa dag dang sgon lam gcig tu spyad/ /grogs sa yag sto dang 'phrad pa gnad che sto red/ grogs kyi shes rab la brten dgos kyi red/rgyal sa ghan dhi rjes gsungs pa red/khong la grogs sto spyod pa ngan pa can zhig yod/de la khong gis sgod pa yag so byed thub pa'i re

40 mkhan chen a pad rin po che/ba byas nas slob ston byas pa yin/ des khong la spyod pa ngan pa de tshur slab nas de'i rjes 'jug byed dgos mkhan/ khong yang spyod pa ngan pa byed mkhan zhig chags song gsungs pa red/ dbe+er na grogs po des ra sha bza' bas khong gis kyang nyin zhig ra sha zos pas nyin gang khong la 1 bde bo ci yang ma byung / ra zhig khog pa'i nang du rgyug bzhin yodad bsam pa'i tshor ba zhig byung gsungs pa red/ bdag byang chub sems dpa'i sgod pa spyad mkhan red/bdag gis spyod pa gang spyad pa dang mtshungs par sgod mkhan gyi grogs so dag dang rtag tu 'grogs par shog lus dang ngag rnams dang ni sems rnams kyis kyang bye da pa gang spyad pa thams cad mnyam por spyad/ chos grogs lta spyod mthun pa de zhe drag gnad 'gag che sto red/ de ma mthun na nyes pa mang po bzo dgos red/ sgon lam yang gcig tu sbyad nam yang de dag mnyam sar spyad pa yin na phar tshur phan tshun gnyis char la phan zog yong gi yod red/de bas na sgon lam thams cad gcig tu spyad par shegag cig gsungs/bdun pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten cing mnyes par byed pa'i sgon lam ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang 'phrad pa dang 'phrad nas thugs mnyes par byed pa'i sgon lam red/bdag la phan par 'dod pa'i grogs sa dag /bzang po spyod pa rab tu ston pa rnams/ /de dag dang yang rtag tu 'phrad par shog /de dag bdag gis nam yang yid mi dbyung / /bdag la phan gcig zog na bsam nas che sa bshad/ rogs pa byed mkhan

bzang sgod 'grel ba/ 41gyi grogs sa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen zer na grogs sto red bla ma zer ba de yang grogs sa red chos yag sa yong bar byed mkhan/ grogs sa ga 'dra zhig dang 'phrad dgos zer na bzang sto sgod pa rab tu ston par cing / bzang po spyod pa zer na zeg pa chen sa'i lam rab tu ston mkhan dge ba'i bshes gnyen de dag dang rtag tu 'phrad par shog cig de dag zer na grogs dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen gnyis po sa dag bdag gis nam yang yid mi dbyung ba ste sems pa zhe log dgos pa/ dper na da mi 'di la mi 'dug bsam dgos pa lta bu nam yang byed par ma gyur cig rtag par thugs mnyes pa byed par gyur cig dge bshes ston pas gsungs pa red khong gis mched grogs de tsho yi dam gyi lha yin bsam bstod pa byas/ mchod pa shul ba sogs byed kyi yod pas nam yang / khong gis log lta dang brnyas bcos la sogs pa nam dus yang skye yi ched zer dam bca' gcig red/ bla ma dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen mnyes par byed par gyur cig gsungs/brgyad pa sangs rgyas kyi zhal la blta ba'i sgon lam ni/sangs rgyas sras kyis bskor ba'i mgon so rnams/ /mngon sum rtag tu bdag gis rgyal ba blta/ /ma 'ongs bskal pa kun tu mi skyo bar/ /de dag la yang mchod pa rgya cher bgyi/ /sangs rgyas ji lta bu zhe na/ sras byang chub sems dpa'i bskor ba'i mgon po rnams mngon gsum du bzhugs pa/ de'ang dus rtag tu/ sus blta na bdag gis blta nus par gyur cig gam sangs rgyas mjal bar gyur cig

42 mkhan chen a pad rin po che/sangs rgyas mjal nas gang byed dgos red zer na/ ma 'ongs bskal pa kun tu sems mi skyo ba ste skyo ba dang ngal thang chad pa sogs me+ed pa'i sgo nas/ de dag te sangs rgyas dang de'i sras byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba de dag la/ mchesad pa rgya che po nam mkha' mtha' dang mnyam pas mche da par bgyi ste mchod pa byed par shegag cigadagu pa dam chos 'dzin pa'i smon lam ni/rgyal ba kun gyi dam pa'i chos 'dzin cing / /byang chub spyod pa kun tu snang bar byed/ /bzang sto spyod pa rnam par sgongs ba yang / /ma 'ongs bskal pa kun tu spyodad par bgyi/ /rgyal ba kun gyi dam pa'i cheras zer na sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i dam pa'i chos gsung rabs yan lag bcu gnyis la sogs pa/ de dag 'dzin cing zer ba na de dag la thos pa byed/ bsam pa byed/ gzhan la bshad pa byed mdor bsdus na nyams len byed pa'i sgo nas dam pa'i chos 'dzin cing / byang chub spyod pa kun tu snang bar byed pa ste byang chub sems dpa'i sgod pa de rnams gzhan sems can kun la chos bshad pa'i sgo nas snang bar byed de shes su bcug bzang po spyod pa ste bzang po sgod pa dang byang chub sgod pa gcig pa'am de dag gi khyad par gong du zhus pa de red/ bzang sa spyod pa dang byang chub spyod pa de kun tu bzang sto'i sgod pa la byas na yang 'grig gi yod red/ bzang po spyod pa rnam par sgong zer rgyu de byang chub sems pa'i sgod pa de rnams dri ma med par byed pa red/ sbyod pa la yag nyes mang so yong gi

bzang sgod 'grel ba/ 43yod red/ dper na nga tshos dge ba 'dra so zhig byas na dge rtsade la dri ma yod sped mang so zhig chags kyi yod red/ dang sa dge rtsazhig spyad na dri dang bcas pa zhig las byedad thub kyi yo da ma red/ de nas rim pas rim par yag du yag du 'gro yi yod red/ de 'dras rang don yid byed kyi dri ma rnam par sgong ba red/ de'i las ka de gsum sa ma 'ongs bskal pa kun tu sgod par bgyi/ zhib cha 'dra bo byas na ma thosangs bskal ba kun tu zhes pa gsung gi mgo la sbyar/ bye da par bgyi zhes pa 'jug la sbyar nas/ dper na ma 'ongs bskal pa kun tu rgyal ba rnams kyi dam pa'i chos 'dzin cing byedad par bgyi/ma 'ongs bskal pa kun tu byang chub sems pa'i spyodad pa kun tu snang bar byed pa spyodad par bgyi/bcu pa yon tan gyi mdzod zob pa'i sgon lam/srid pa thams cad du yang 'khor ba na/ /bsodad nams ye shes dag ni mi zad brnyes/ /thabs dang shes rab ting 'dzin rnam thar dang / /yon tan kun gyi mi zad mdzod du gyur/ /srid pa thams cad du khams gsum 'kho ra ba na 'khor ba'i gnas skabs su/ bsodad nams zer na ṣ+ṭṛn pa tshul khrims bzod pa lta bu/ ye shes zer na bsam gtan dang shes rab de dag mi zad brnyes te zad rgyu med pa'i yodan tan thob pa dang / de bzhin du thabs zer na sems bskyed dang / shes rab zer na bdag me+ed rtogs pa'i shes rab lta thu/ ting 'dzin zer na nam mkha' mdzod kyi ting nge 'dzin lta bu/rnam thar zer na rnam thar brgyad gzugs can gzugs

44 mkhan chen a pad rin po che/la blta ba'i rnam thar la se gas pa/ de min pa'i rnam thar sgo gsum zer ba sodags yod red de/ 'di thun mong ma yin pa byang chub sems dpa'i rnam thar la go rgyu yin gsungs dus de ltar na thogs pa me+ed pa snying rje'i rnam thar zer ba de dza yod red de yo dang / la sogs pa ste mdor na yon tan kun gyis mi zad mdzod/ mdzod zer na rgyal so che sa la bang mdzod zad du me+ed pa de 'dra yod red de 'dra yi yon tan gyi mdzod brnyes par gyur cig gsungs pa red/ de yan chad kyis byang chub sems dpa' so dmo skye sa tshogs lam dang sbyongar lam gnas pa'i yodan tan thams cad rang gzhan thams cad kyi rgyud la 'byor ba'i sgon lam red/ sde gzhung mchog sprul rin po ches gsungs kyi 'dug yon tan kun gyi mi zad mdzod du gyur zhes pa 'di sa dang po thob pa'i sgon lam red gsungs kyi 'dug gzhung gi nang du yang yin mdog kha sa yod red/ sa dang po de nas yon tan gyi mdzod gsar du brnyes kyi yod red/ rdul gcig steng na man chad de 'phags pa'i gang zag sa dang po nas bzung te sa bcu pa'i bar byang chub sems dpa' yodan tan thams cad la longs byedad thub pa'i sgon lam red/ de'i don dag de tsho bgos 'dra sa byas na longs spyod dang sgon lam gnyis/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan la longs sgod thub pa'i sgon lam dang / sangs rgyas zob pa'i sgon lam gnyis/ byang chub sems dpa' de la 'phags pa dang so so'i skye sto gnyis/ 'di man chad 'phags pa'i yodan tan zob pa smon pa/ rgya 'grel rnams ltar don tshan bcu drug tsho bgo sa byas pa yin na/ bcu gcig pa sangs rgyas kyi spyodad yul las 'das pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing la 'jug pa'i sgon lam zer rgyu de red/ de rdzogs smin

bzang spyod 'grel ba/ 45sbyangs gsum kyi nang nas sems can smin pa zer ba de red/bcu gcig pa 'jug pa du ma'i sgo nas zhing sgongs ba'i sgon lam/ de la yang 'jug pa brgyad yod pa las/ dang sa sangs rgyas kyi zhal blta bar 'jug pa'i smon lam/rdul gcig steng na jul snyed zhing rnams te/ /zhing der bsam kyi mi khyab sangs rgyas rnams/ /sangs rgyas sras kyi dbus na bzhugs pa la/ /byang chub sgod pa spyod cing blta bar bkyi/ /dang sa sangs rgyas kyi zhal mazong ba'i sgon lam/ rdul phran chung chung gcig gi steng na rdul phran ji sted yod pa'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams rnams der/ zhing rnams de na bsam gyi mi khyab pa ste grangs ka slo yi yul las 'das pa'i sangs rgyas mang sto/ de'ang sgu rkyang ma yin pa sangs rgyas kyi sras kyi dbus na bzhugs pa la/ byang chub sems dpa'i byedad pa spyod/ mchod pa shul/ chos nyan pa la sogs pa'i don du blta bar bgyi ste mthong nus par 〈snag cig gsungs pa red/gnyis pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams la 'jug pa'i sgon lam/de ltar ma lus thams cad phyogs su yang / /skra tsam rjan la dus gsum tshad sted kyi/ /sangs rgyas rgya mtsho zhing rnams rgya mtsho dang / /bskal ba rgya mtsho spyod cing rab tu 'jug /rdul phran gcig gi go sa na rdul sted kyi sangs rgyas bzhugs pa mthong nus

46 mkhan chen a pad rin po che/par gyur cig gsungs/ de ltar zer na rdul phran gcig gi steng na rdul snyed kyi sangs rgyas bzhugs pa de ltar du/ ma lus pa'i phyogs rnams thams cad kyi/ go sa chung chung skra tsam gyi khyon la dus skad cig ma gcig gi steng du dus gsum gyi rdul phran la grangs tshad ji snyed yod pa de snyed kyi sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ zhing khams rgya mtsho/ skra tsam kyi khyon na ste skra yi rtsepo ra na tsul phran chung chung de'i khyon na/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas mang sa sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams rgya mtsho/dus skad cig ma gcig gi steng du zer na dus tshod thung shegs red/ shin tu dus tshod thung thung la skad cig ma zer/ nad med gcig gis se gol gcig gtog pa'i yun tshad la skad cig ma cha drug bcu re bzhi yin nam re lnga yin nam gcig yod red/ de'ang rags pa red/ zul phran gcig gcig gi go sa na 'gro ba'i yun tshad la dus kyi skad cig ma red/ de gcig gi steng du bskal pa rgya mtsho sbyod cing sangs rgyas rnams rab tu 'jug de lta bu'i sangs rgyas rnams bdag gis mjal zub par gyur cig de sangs rgyas kyi zhing la 'jug pa'i sgon lam zer ba de red/gsum pa sangs rgyas kyi gsung la 'jug pa'i smon lam sangs rgyas kyi sbyod yul la 'jug pa'i sgon lam/ sangs rgyas kyi sgod yul zer na sangs rgyas kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i mdzad sgod de dag la 'jug thub par gyur cigadang sto gsung gi gsang ba/gsungs gcig yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra kun gyis/ /rgyal ba kun dbyangs yan lag rnam dag pa/ /'gro ba kun gyi bsam pa ji bzhin dbyangs/ /

bzang sgod 'grel ba/ 47sangs rgyas gsungs la rtag tu 'jug par bgyi/ /sangs rgyas kyi gsung gcig la yan lag mang po yod red/ sangs rgyas ma yin pa de dag la gsung gcig la yan lag re re min pa yod ma red/skad phra sgom 'dra sto gcig ma gtogs yong shes kyi ma red/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung gcig la yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra skad yod red/ 'jam pa dang / snyan pa dang / rgyang ring du grags pa la sogs pa/ dus rgyun sangs rgyas kyi gsung la yan lag drug bcu bshad kyi yod red/ de'ang mtshon pa tsam red yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra kun gyis rgyal ba sangs rgyas kun gyis dbyangs yan lag mang so yod pa dang / yan lag de dag re re bzhin du skyon med pas rnam par dag pa yon tan gnyis bshad pa red/ de nas 'gro ba kun gyi bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi dbyangs/ nga tsho mi gzhan dag gis skad cha bshad na go sa 'dra sto byung na min pa gcig ma gtogs go rgyu yod ma red/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung de la gdul bya ga tshod yod pa de tshod kyi so sos 'dra mi 'dra go na 'grig gi red/ dper na da lta'i bka' 'gyur nang gi yab sras mjam ba'i mdo la se gas pa gsum sangs rgyas kyis chos gcig gsungs sa la gdul bya ma 'dra ba gsum gyis bzung nas mdo gsum chags sdad yodad red/ 'gro ba kun gyi bsam pa la ji lta ba bzhin du 'jug pa'i dbyangs sam gsung de la rtag tu 'jug par bgyi ste de 'dra'i gsung yag sto thub par shogag cig gsungs/ des dbyangs mang so yod pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gsungs zob par shog cig gsungs pa red/ brjod bya sna tshogs ston pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gsung job par gyur cig

48 mkhan chen a pad rin po che/bzhi pa chos 'khor bskor ba la 'jug pa'i sgon lam/dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad dag /'khor lo'i tshul rnams rab tu bskor ba yi/ /de dag gi yang gsungs dbyangs mi zad la/ /blo yi stobs kyis bdag kyang rab tu 'jug /dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyis brjod bya sna tshogs ston pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo'i tshul rnams rab tu bskor ba yi/ sangs rgyas de dag gi gsungs dbyangs nam mkha' ma stong gi bar du mi zad pa rtag par gsungs la 'jug pa yin dus/ 'gre las la rdzogs ya med pa yin pa red/ ngo ma sangs rgyas kyi gsung de'i re re yi don dag rdzogs ya yod ma red/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung de mi 'dra ba red/ bshad shes mkhan zhig gis bshad/ bsam shes mkhan zhig gis bsam pa yin na sangs rgyas kyi gsung gcig gi don tshan de la rdzogs ya med pa zhig yod red/ de'i byir na mi zad pa la gsungs pa red/ rang gi slo stobs kyi sgo nas bdag gis yang dag pa 'jug zob par shog cig gsungs/ brjod bya sna tshogs bston pa'i gsung red/ gong du bshad pa'i sangs rgyas kyis dngos rnams 'grub par gyur cig zer/ 'dis sangs rgyas gsung gcig gis don dag mang po bstan gyi 'dug de thob par gyur cig gsungs/lnga pa rdzu 'phrul gyi gsung la 'jug thub pa'i sgon lam/ma 'ongs bskal pa thams cad 'jug par yang / /skad cig gcig gis bdag kyang 'jug par bgyi/ /

bzang spyod 'grel ba/ 49gang yang bskal pa dus gsum tshad de dag /skad cig cha shas kyis ni zhugs par spyad/ /ma 'ongs pa'i bskal pa thams cad rim gyis 'jug pa de yang / sangs rgyas kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis dbang gis skad cig gcig gis 'jug gi yod red/ de bzhin du bdag kyang 'jug thub par gyur cig sangs rgyas kyis bskal pa mang po skad cig du bsdom gyi yod red/ bdag gis kyang de bzhin du 'jug zub par gyur cig de'ang ga 'dra red zer na gang yang bskal pa dus gsum du srid tshad bskal ba de dag skad cig ril so ma zad skad cig cha shas kyi yun tshad la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis 'jug pa de bzhin du bdag kyang 'jug thub par gyur cig mdor na sangs rgyas kyis bskal pa skad cig bsgyur thub pa de bzhin du bdag gis kyang bsgyur thub par shegag gsungs pa red/ ga 'dra byed dgos red zer na/ sprul sgu rin po ches gsungs kyi 'dugadaper na maṇ+ḍal 'dra sa gcig phral na yang 'di bsam dgo sa red gsungs/dus zer ba de blos phar bzos bzhag pa don gyi thog la yod ma red/ byas tsang bskal pa grangs med mang po tshogs da lta maṇ+ḍal tshar gcig gis rdzogs par byed dgos bsam pa'i blo stobs bskyed nas/ de nas maṇ+ḍal 'dra lha shul na tshogs chen so rdzogs thub kyi yod red gsungs pa red/ 'di bzang spyod kyi skabs la dog daphyod byed dgos ya de/ yul gyi sgo nas rdul gcig gi steng du rdul sted kyi 7)ga rten yod zer gyi red/ de'ang rdul phran zer na zhe drag chung chung red de'i steng na rdul ji sted pa'i grangs ka dang mnyam pa'i zhing khams dang sangs rgyas yod zhes gsungs pa red/ de yang go khag sto

50 mkhan chen a pad rin po che/yod red/ rdul phran gcig gi steng du ḍūl phran ji snyed pa'i grangs ka dang mnyam pa'i zhing khams dang sangs rgyas yodad zer yodang dus/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams dang sangs rgyas chung du 'gro rgyu yod ma red/ rdul phran che ru 'gro rgyu yod ma red/ dus gsum de skad cig gcig la bsdu yi yod red gsungs pa red/ skad cig dang bskal ba zhe drag 'gal ba red/ de la yun ring thung gi khyad par zhe drag yod red/ de gang red zhe na de sangs rgyas kyi rdzu 'phrul yin bsam na 'greg gi yodad yin pa red/ rdzu 'phrul de 'dra bstan rgyu yod red dbu ma 'jug pa'i nang du/ rdul rags mi 'gyur 'jig rten phra mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs yod red/ 'jigs byed kyi bstod pa'i nang du rdul phran gcig la 'jig rten mgo na zhes gsungs pa lta bu red/ des 'di tsho rdzu 'phrul rkyang pa ma red/ sprul sku rin sa ches gnas tshul red gsungs kyi 'dug gnas tshul ga 'dra red zhe na/ yul gyi zog la che chung khye na nas yodad ma red/ che chung zer ba de rnam rtog gis bzo bzhag pa red/ byas tsang che chung khyon nas sped pa'i gnas tshul de mthong na de nas yul gyi thog na rdul phran gcig gi thog na 'jig rten yong gi yod gsungs/ de'ang lam 'bras kyi nang du 'gal 'du skyon sped pa'i dpyad pa zer rgyu de dag so so skyes bu blo ro la 'gal ba 'dus sdad pa 'dra sa red yin na yang don la skyon sped pa zhig red/dus tshod yang de tso rang red dus tshod ring thung yang so so'i rnam rtog gis bzos bzhag pa red don du grub pa yod ma red/ des na don gyi steng du skad cig dang bskal pa la khyad par yodad ma red gsungs/ dus tshod bden pa sed pa rtogs tshar ba dang yul bden pa med pa rte gas tshar ba'i byang chub sems

bzang spyod 'grel ba/ 51dpa' dang sangs rgyas de tsho la bskal pa dang skad cig rdul phran dang zul snyed kyi 'jig rten khyad par me+ed pa red/ dbu ma pas bshad na che chung zer ba brten 'brel red ma gtogs rang bzhin yod ma red gsungs/ dper na khu byug 'dra sto zhig yin na chung chung dang che sa red zhes bshad shes kyi ma red/yin na'ang khang pa 'dra sa la bltos na chung chung red/ grog ma 'dra so la bltos na chen sa red/ byas tsang khu byug gcig che chung gnyis yong srid kyi ma red de phar bstos nas bzhag bzhag pa red/ dper na mtho gang de ring so red thung thung red zer na/ ring sa la bltos na thung ngu red/ thung ngu la bltos na ring po red/ bstos na ma gtogs bshad shes kyi ma red/ byas tsang bstos nas bzhag pa zer dus don la med pa red/ dper na mi la ras pa g.yag rwa'i sbug du bzhugs pa red/ de dus mi la chung du ma sodang g.yag rwa'i sbug che ru ma phyin pa red/ de nas ras chung pa la bka' gnang nas/ bu pha rjes 'jug na 'di na shogag /gnas bde ba yangs pa 'di na 'dug /gsungs pa red/ gnas yangs po zhe'u 'dug khyed nga dang 2 na 'di na shog gsungs red/ zhang bsgo ma pa ba zhu ba de sa chen gyi bla ma red/ sa chen gyis lam 'bras zhus lam 'bras tshar yong dus/ gsang sngags pa zhes pa de bla ma la dad pa gnad che sa red gsungs nas/ dad pa skye thabs la rdzu 'phrul mang sa zhig bstan pa red/ khong bzhugs sa'i lung pa de ding zer ba der red/ de'i lung pa gang ga bskyil dkrung gcig gis khebs pa mdzad nas/ zhang ston kyi sku che ru ma song lung pa chung du ma phyin pa bsnyan pa red/ de don la che chung yangs dog sped pa'i don red/ yangs dog me+ed pa'i don mngon sum du rtogs song na de 'dra
