52 mkhan chen a pad rin po che/byed thub kyi red/ rong zom paṇa chen gyis kyang de yi bskor mang so gsungs pa red/ de'ang dper na pe long chung chung zhig gi nang gzugs bsnyen chen sa shar thub kyi yod red/ de'i nang la phyi nang gi rim pa yod ma red de rim pa rgya chen so 'dug bsam pa 'dra sto 'char gyi yod red/ dus tshod ring thung de tsho nged tsho blo la nges pa med pa 'dra sto bsam 1 gtong thub kyi yod red/dper na sems pa skyed sa 'dra yod na chu tshod de mgyogs sa rdzogs 'gro ba dang / sems pa snyed so sed dka' las khag so yodad na/ gnyid med pa mtshan mo ring / /ngal bar gyur la dpag tshad ring / /zer ba nang bzhin chu tshod dang dus tshod de yun ring so 'gor 'gro yi yod red/ dper na mtshan mo gnyid nyal 'dug dus lo mang po'i bya ba gnyid thun gcig gi rmi lam thung thung zhig gi nang du rmis thub kyi yod red/ dus tshod la ring thung med pa de 'dra yin pa red/drug pa rdzu 'phrul gyi byedad pa la 'jug thub pa'i sgon lam/dus gsum gshegs pa mi seng ge gang / /de dag skad cig gcig la bdag gis blta/ /rtag tu de dag gi ni spyodad yul la/ /sgyu mar gyur ba'i rnam thar stobs kyis 'jug /dus gsum du gshegs pa'i mi seng ge gang yin pa'i sangs rgyas de dag la dus skad cig ma gcig la bdag gis de dag blta nus par gyur cig dus rtag tu sangs rgyas de dag gi sbyo da yul du byed thub gzhan dag gis byed mi thub pa 'ga'/ sgyur mar gyur pa'i rnam thar te kun tu bzang pa'i rnam thar dang

bzang spyod 'grel ba/ 53gcig pa red gsungs kyi 'dug don chos thams cad sgyu ma dang mig 'khrul lta bu rtogs pa'i rnam thar gyi sgo nas skad cig dang bskal pa gnyis khyad maid par/ rdul phran dang 'jig rten gyi khams rgya che po de dag dang khyad par med pa/ de 'dra ba'i yul la sgyur mar gyur pa'i rnam thar gyis stobs kyi 'jug nus par shegag cig sde gzhung sprul sgu rin so ches gsungs kyi 'dug mig 'phrul lta bu'i ting 'dzin la gnas nas ni/ /skad cig la yang bskal pa'i tshogs sdom zhing / /sngon du rdzogs smin sbyangs ba thabs bzang 'dis/ /kun bzang rnam thar byang bar byin gyis rlobs/ /de bzang sgod kyi don dag red/bdun pa zhing spyongs ba 'jug pa'i sgon lam/gang yang dus gsum dag zhing gi bkod pa/ /de dag rdul gcig steng na mngon par bsgrub/ /de ltar ma lus phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /rgyal ba dag gis zhing rnams bkod la 'jug /gang yang dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyi bkod pa de dag dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyis so so sangs rgyas pa'i zhing khams gang 'dra yod pa yin na de dag bdag gis rdul phran gcig gi steng du mngon par sgrub thub par gyur cig rdul phran gcig gi steng du sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams cha tshang gcig bsgrub pa de bzhin du/ ma lus pa'i byedags rnams te nam mkhas gar khyab kyi phyogs rnams thams cad du rgyal ba rnams kyi zhing khams kyi bko da pa la 'jug thub par gyur cig rang nyid sangs rgyas 'gro ba'i zhing khams de rgya chen so dang yag sa sogs 'byung bar shesag cig de nas zhing khams de na 'di

54 mkhan chen a pad rin po che/'dra byed thub par gyur cig gsungs pa red/brgyad pa ma byon pa'i mgon so kun gyi drung du 'jug pa'i sgon lam/gang yang ma byon 'jig rten sgon ma rnams/ /byang chub rim par 'tshang rgya 'khor lo bskor/ /mya ngan 'das pa rab tu zhi mtha' ston/ /mgon so kun gyi drung du bdag 'chi'o/ /gang yang ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas te 'das pa'i sangs rgyas dang da lta'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis mdzad pa bstan pa rnams smosas mi dgo sa pa ma zad/ma 'ongs pa'i 'jig rten gyi sgon ma zer na ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/lam gyi rim pa bzhin du byang chub te 'tshang rgya ba/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba/ mya ngan las 'das pa rab tu zhi ba'i mtha' sodags mdzad pa thams cad zhing khams de na rdzu 'phrul gyis sgo nas ston thub par gyur cig de bzhin du rdzu 'phrulagyi sgo nas mgon sto ste rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi drung du bdag 'chi ste/ bdag mchod pa phul ba dang / chos spyod pa la sogs don du bdag 'gro bar nus par shogag cig gsungs/bcu gnyis pa stodabs bsam gyi mi khyab pa the ba pa'i sgo na lam/kun tu myur ba'i rdzu 'phrul stobs rnams dang / /kun nas sgo yi zeg pa'i stobs dag dang / /shārdo spya/sa dh+rit+t+waṃ bye dṛdze+e dībye bye/ 'phrushāb zlo snyeḍirdo spya rdo pyo ṅgiṣ+ṭṛdhi bye byedhibye bcu na 'gro thub pa'i kun tu myur ba'i rdzu 'phru zhes pa de'i stobs/ stobs zer

bzang sgod 'grel ba/ 55na mi mthun pa'i phyogs spang bya yis tshur gzhom mi thub pa'i nus pa/ de 'dra thub par sa ga cig gsungs pa red/ kun nas sgo yi theg pa zer na zeg pa che po la zer gyi yod red/ zeg chen la kun nas sgo yi zeg pa zer dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ sgo mang po nas sems can gyi don byed pa'i theg pa yin pas kun nas sgo yi theg pa de 'dra ba'i stobs sab par shesag cigakun tu yon tan sgod pa'i stobs rnams dang / /kun tu khyab pa byams pa dag gi stobs/ /stobs bcu bshad dus kun tu yon tan dang sgod pa'i stobs so sor bye dgos pa red/ stobs dgu bshad na mnyam po yin sa red rtsatshig gi nang du stobs stobs zer ba dgu ma gtogs med pa red/dus kun tu dge ba'i yon tan spyodad pa de byang chub sems dpa'i spyodad pa red/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyodad pa'i stobs rnams dang / kun tu khyab pa zer na sems can thams cad la khyab pa'i phan bde byung na bsam pa kun tu khyab pa'i byams pa'i stobs dang /kun nas dge ba'i bsod nams stobs dag dang / /chags pa med par gyur pa'i ye shes stobs/ /kun nas dge ba'ibasod nams zer na dus gsum kun na dge ba'i bsod nams gsum te sbyin pa/ tshul khrims/ sgom byed pa stobs de 'dra ba'i bsod nams gsum dang / chags pa med par gyur pa'i ye shes stobs zer na chags thogs med pa'i yeshes kyis shes bya kha shas shes/ shes bya kha shas mi shes pa lta bu de 'dra ma yin pa ye shes kyi stobs dang /shes rab thabs dang ting 'dzin stobs dag gis/ /

56 mkhan chen a pad rin po che/byang chub stobs rnams yang dag sgrub par byed/ /shes rab zer na chos rab rnam 'byed kyi shes rab la zer/ thabs zer na ting nge 'dzin dpa' bar 'gro ba dang / nam mkha' mdzod la sogs pa'i stobs ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs dgu yod red/ stobs stobs zer na yon tan de dag spang bya yis d+mad pa byed mi thub mkhan/ dper na nged tsho las dang yo ba la yon tan dka' las khag so yod red/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yon tan de slo bur ba'i rang bzhin chags sdad yod red/ spang byas des 1 bur du yodan tan med pa byed 'gro ba de 'dra ma yin pa/ mi mthun phyogs kyis brdzi mi nus pa yin pas stobs gsungs pa red/ stobs dgu po dag gis byang chub kyi stobs te sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang red/ stobs zer dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan de nus pa che so yodad pa yin pas sgu gsum 'phri las dang bcas pa la gsungs pa red/ yang na stobs bcu lta bu la go na 'dom bde sa yin pa red/byang chub kyi stobs rnams yang dag par sgrub par byed par gyur cigabacu gsum pa spang bya zad pa'i ye shes che po thob pa'i sgon lam/las kyi stobs rnams yongs su rdzogs byed cing / /nyon mongs stobs rnams kun tu 'joms par byed/ /bdud kyi stobs rnams stobs d+mad rab byed cing / /bzang so spyod pa'i stobs ni rdzogs par bgyi/ /las zer na zag bcas kyi las mtho ris dang ngan song du skye bar byed pa'i las kyi stobs rnams yongs su dag nas mid par byed/ nyon mongs pa'i stobs de rnams kun kyang 'jom par byed/ bdud dga' rab dbang phyug la

bzang sgod 'grel ba/ 57sogs pa rnams kyi stobs med pa byed par gyur cig de gnyen sto gang gis sgo nas stobs gsum po med par byed dgos zhe na/ bzang so spyod pa'i stobs te gnyen po byang chub sems dpa'i lam gyi stobs rnams rdzogs par bgyi te rdzogs par shog cig gsungs/bcu bzhi pa 'phri las sna tshogs byed thub pa'i sgon lam/ byed las sags pa med par 'jug pa'i sgon lam/zhing khams rgya mtsho rnam par dag byed cing / /sems can rgya mtsho dag ni rnam par grol/ /zhing khams kyi rgya mtsho nged sdod sa'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di dag rdo dang /tsher ma/ 'bar 'bur/ rtsub yo la sogs de 'dra ma yin pa rnam par dag cing te/ bde ba can gyi zhing ltar rnam par dag cing yangs shing rgya che sto 'gyur ba dang / sems can rgya mtsho zer na mang po red/ sems can rnams ni cho 'phrul gsum dang khyad par du chos bshad pa'i sgo nas sgol bar gyur cigachos rnams rgya mtsho rab tu mthong byed cing / /chos zer na gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis lta bu shes bya'i chos dang /sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang lta bu zob bya'i chos de rnams/ chos kyi rgya mtsho de rnams shes rab kyi mig gis mthong bar byed cing /ye shes rgya mtsho rab tu rtogs par byed/ /ye shes rgya mtsho zer na bdag med rtogs pa'i ye shes mang so sa dang sto nas bzung te sangs rgyas kyi sa yi bar gyi ye shes rnams rab tu rtogs pa ste skye bar byed/

58 mkhan chen a pad rin po che/sgod pa rgya mtsho rnam par dag byed cing / /ṣ+ṭṛn pa gtong ba la sogs pa'i sgod pa rgya mtsho rang don du ma yin pa rnam par dag pa byed/sgon lam rgya mtsho yongs su rdzogs par byed/ /sgon lam rgya mtsho ste byang chub sems dpa'i btabs pa'i sgon lam de la grangs me+ed 'bum phrag bcu yod gsungs kyi 'dugasgon lam che so la sogs pa'i grangs med 'bum phrag rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed cing /sangs rgyas rgya mtsho rab tu mchod byed cing / /sangs rgyas rgya mtsho lta bu de dag la rab tu mchod pa 'bul bar byed cing /bskal ba rgya mtshor mi skyo spyad par bgyi/ /bskal ba rgya mtsho ste gong du bshad ma thag pa'i las ka bdun so de bskal ba rgya mtsho'i bar du mi skyo bar spyad par bgyi ste spyod par gyur cig gsungs/de las sna tshogs byed pa'i sgon lam red/bcu lnga pa sangs rgyas dang byang sems kyi rjes su slob pa'i sgon lam/ de la sangs rgyas kyi rjes su slob pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rjes su slob pa gnyis las/ dang sto ni/ da ni sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rjes su slob pa'i sgon lam ni/ sangs rgyas kyis sgon lam ji ltar btabs pa nang bzhin smon lam zebs kyi red gsungs pa red/ rdzogs sten sbyangs gsum la tsho bgos byas pa yin na de yan chad kyis zhing sgong ba bstan red/gang yang dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba yis/ /

bzang sgod 'grel ba/ 59byang chub sgod pa'i sgon lam bye brag rnams/ /bzang yo sgod pa'i byang chub sangs rgyas nas/ /de kun bdag gis ma lus rdzogs par bgyi/ /gang yang dus gsum du gshegs pa'i rgyal ba yis byang chub spyod pa'i sgon lam gyi bye brag ji snyed zhig btabs pa de dag dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyis byang chub sems dpa'i sgon lam mang po btabs yod red/ de rnams thams cad bdag gis rdzogs thub par gyur cig gang 'dra byas nas rdzogs par bgyi zhe na/ bzang sto spyodad pa ste byang chub sems dpa'i lam nyams su blang pa la brten nas/ /de nas rang nyid byang chub te mngon par rdzogs pa sangs rgyas te/ de nas dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyis btabs pa'i sgon lam kun bdag gis ma lus par yongs su rdzogs pa byed nus par shog cig gsungs pa red/gnyis pa byang chub sems dpa'i rjes su slob pa/ da byang chub sems dpa'i rjes su slob pa'i sgon lam ni/ de la mdor bstan pa dang / rgyas par bshad pa gnyis las/ dang sto ni/rgyal ba kun gyi sras kyi thu bo ba/ /gang gi ming ni kun tu bzang zhes ga /mkhas pa de dang mtshungs par sbyad pa'i byer/ /dge ba 'di dag thams cad rab tu baljo/ /rgyal ba kun gyi sras zer na sangs kyi rigs tshang ma/ sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thu bo 'ar na sras drag shos sam/ che shos de lta bu gang gi

60 mkhan chen a pad rin po che/ming la kun tu bzang po zhes bya gsungs/ kun tu bzang po la sras kyi thu sa zer dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin zhe na/ shākya bshes gnyen gyi 'grel ba nang du gsungs yod red gsungs kyi 'dug byang chub sems dpa' la gnyis yod red/ kun tu 'dod chen pa dang 'dod chen pa ma yin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' gnyis/ 'dod chen pa'i nang nas dang po de rgyal tshab byams pa red zer/ des na byams pa la sras kyi thu bo ra red/ 'dod chen pa ma yin pa gzhon nu'i sa ba zer ba de nas/ sems bskyed stobs chen byed mkhan dang / byang chub sems dpa' yin bzhin du sems can gyi don mdzad mkhan de byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang sto red/ des na kun tu bzang sa la sras kyi thu bo 'ar gyi red gsungs kyi 'dug gang gi ming la kun tu bzang yo zhes pa'i ming de/ byang chub sems dpa' de la sangs rgyas mang sas gnang ba yin pa red/ gnang dbo sa pa'i rgyu mtshan byang chub sems dpa' de phyogs gang du bzhugs na yang de'i phyogs de mdze+es par byed pa yin dus kun tu bzang sto gsungs pa red/ mkhas pa de dang mtshungs par spyad par bya ba'i phyir du dge ba 'di dag thams cad kun tu bzang sas ji ltar rab tu bsngo ba mdzad pa de bzhin du baljo bar byed yin gsungs pa red/ de gcig gi nang du gsungs 'dug baljo ba de thabs shes zung 'jug dang 'khor gsum mi dmigs pas baljo ba byed dgos red/ thabs shes zung 'jug byed stangs mang so yod red/ dper na stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab dang bsdo ba gnyis mnyam po/ de ma shes na yang dang sa bsngo ba 'jug tu de stong pa nyid yin bsam/ de 'dra yang rang gis byed ma shes yin na kun tu bzang sto dang 'jam

bzang spyod 'grel ba/ 61pa'i dbyangs gang 'dra byed kyi yod na de 'dra byed yin bsam na yang 'khor gsum mi dmigs par gyur 'gro ba red/gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa/ kun tu bzang po'i rjes su ste ba pa dang /'jam dpal dbyangs kyi rjes su slob pa gnyis las/ dang so ni/lus dang ngag dang yid kyang rnam dag cing / /spyod pa rnam dag zhing rnams yongs dag pa/ /basbyo ngab bzang po mkhas pa ci 'dra ba/ /de 'dra bdag kyang de dang mtshungs par she ga /kun tu bzang sos baljo ba gang 'dra byed kyi red zhe na/ lus dag pa rang don yid byed kyi skyon med pa/ ngag dag pa/ yid rnam par dag pa/ bye da pa yang rnam par dag zhing khams kyang rnam par dag de 'dra lus dag ngag dag yid dag spyod pa dag zhing dag de rnams shin tu dag na bsngo ba bzang sa gyur pa red gsungs/ baljo ba bzang so 'di la mdzad pa zer mkhan zhig kyang 'dugamakhas pa yang 'grig yin pa red/ kun tu bzang po bajo ba bzang so byed pa la mkhas pa ci 'dra ba de dang 'dra ba bdag kyang de dang mtshungs par gyur cigaganyis pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rjes su slob pa/kun nas dge ba bzang po spyad pa'i phyir/ /'jam dpal gyi ni smon lam spyad par bgyi/ /ma 'ongs bskal pa kun tu mi skyo dbar/ /de yi bya ba ma lus rdzogs par bgyi/ /phyogs dang dus gsum kun nas dge ba bzang po spyod nga dang / byang chub

62 mkhan chen a pad rin po che/sems dpa'i sgod pa spyad pa'i phyir du rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sgon lam de rnams bdag gis spyad par bkyi/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis smon lam gang 'dra btabs pa red zhe na/ dper na chu bo gaṅga'i 'gram gyi bye ma snyed kyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams na/ sangs rgyas bsam gyi mi khyab pa zhig yod red/ sangs rgyas bsam gyi mi khyab pa de re re'i drung du 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sku re re bstan nas/ sangs rgyas kyi 'gre las 'grub pa'i sgon lam btabs pa red gsungs/ de 'dra'i san lam de grub par gyur cig ma 'ongs bskal pa kun tu de 'dra yun ring byed pa la skyo ngal sped par sgon lam gang btabs pa de'i bya ba ma lus pa de rnams 'grub par gyur cigade yan chad kyis byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan rang rgyud la 'jug pa'i sgon lam red/bcu drug pa don bsdu ba'i san lam ni/ don tshan bcu drug tu tsho bgos byas pa yin na 'jug bsdud red/ de nas byang sems dang sangs rgyas gnyis su tsho bgos byas pa yin na sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thob pa'i sgon lam red/sbyod pa dag ni tshad yod ma gyur cig /yon tan rnams kyang tshad bzung sped par shog /spyodad pa tshad me+ed pa la gnas nas kyang / /de dag 'khrul ba thams cad 'tshal bar bgyi/ /sgod pa zer na sgo gsum gyi sgod pa/ chos byed pa'i sbyod pa de tsho sangs rgyas ma yin thams cad kyi sbyod pa la tshad yod red/ sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa mdzad pa 'phri las la tshad yod ma red/ skad cig gcig gi mdzad pa la yang

bzang spyod 'grel ba/ 63tshad yod ma red/ tshad yod par ma gyur par/ sgod pa tshad med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par gyur cig yon tan rnams kyang te sangs rgyas ma yin pa rnams la 'di'i yon tan 'di red zhes tshad bzung yod red/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi yon tan tshad ped pa de dag thob par shogag cig sgod pa tshad med pa la gnas nas kyang 'phrul ba zer na rdzu 'phrul red/ rdzu 'phrul ma lus pa thams cad bdag gis tshar ba ste yodangs su rdzogs pa shes pa'am thob par shogag cigagasum pa don bsdus pas baljo ba/ de la smon lam kyi mtha' dang / bzang sbyod kyi phan yon gnyis las/ dang sa ni sgon lam gyi mtha' ni/nam mkha'i mthar thug gyur pa ji tsam par/ /sems can ma lus mtha' yang de bzhin te/ /ji tsam las dang nyon mongs mthar gyur pa/ /bdag gi sgon lam mtha' yang de tsam mo/ /nam mkha'i mthar thug ji tsam pa ste nam mkha' de la mtha' 〈snad ma red/ de yi mtha' ped pa nang bzhin sems can ma lus mtha' yang de ga nang bzhin mtha' yod ma red gsungs pa red/ gong du rdul gcig gi steng du rdul snyed kyi 'jig rten yod gsungs pa nang bzhin red/ nged tsho'i theg dman gyi mdo yi nang du gsungs red/ shing phung spang ba tsam gyi khyon na stong gsum gyi mi las mang ba'i dud 'gro'i sems can yod red/ byas tsang nged tsho'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams dang / bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i 'jig rten gyi mang sto yod red/ des na sems can

64 mkhan chen a pad rin po che/gyis khengs bzhin yod red/ byas tsang sems can ma lus mtha' yang de bzhin de/ sems can ji tsam yod pa de tsam gyi las dang nyon mongs pa yod red/ ji tsam las dang nyon mongs pa'i mtha' gyur pa bdag gi sgon lam mtha' yang de tsam yin gsungs/ des sgon lam de yul gyi dbang du byas na nam mkha'i mthar khyab sems can thams cad la/ dus tshod kyi dbang du byas na nam mkha' ma zhig 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du sems can thams cad la phan ོga thub pa de sgon lam gyi mtha' dang tshad yin gsungs/gnyis pa bzang sbyod kyi phan yon bshad na/ phan yon la tshe 'di la thob pa'i phan yon dang / rmya ma phan chad la thob pa'i phan yon/ 'di phyi gnyis la thob pa'i phan yon gyi don bsdu ba dang gsum las/ dang po la don tshan bzhi yod red/ bsod nams rgya cher zob pa dang / sangs rgyas masang ba/ byang chub sems dpa' dang bskal ba mnyam pa/ las sgrib byang ba/ dang so bsod nams chen po thob pa phan yon/gang yang phyogs bcu'i zhing rnams mtha' yas pa/ /rin chen brgyan te rgyal ba rnams la phul/ /yang phyogs bcu'i zhing khams dang mtha' yas pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi khyon na rin sa ches rgyan pa te/ rin sa ches bkang te rgyal ba rnams la phul na/ sgod che sa 'jig rten gyi khams/ 'bul rgyu'i dngos sa yag sa zhe drag red/ 'bul sa rgyal ba rnams red bsod nams che po bsog par 'gyur/lha dang mi yi bde ba'i mchog rnams kyang / /

bzang sgod 'grel ba/ 65zhing gi rdul sted bskal par phul ba bas/ /de tsam ma zad lha dang mi yi bde ba'i mchog zer na/ dngos so yag po red dngos po yag po de tshos bde ba skyed kyi yod pa red/ bde ba skyed mkhan gyi dngos so yag sos 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad bkang te/ 'bul sa sangs rgyas rnams la/ dus tshod ga tshod kyi bar du zhe na/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams kyi rdul phran gyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i bskal ba'i bar du phul na phan yodan bsam gyi mi khyab pa rgya che sa zhig yodad red gsungs/ de bas kyang bzang sgod 4de tshar gcig bton na phan yon che ba red gsungs pa red/gang gis bajo ba'i rgyal sa 'di jos nas/ /byang chub mchedag gi rjes su rab modas shing / /lan gcig tsam yang dad pa bskyed pa na/ /bsod nams dam pa'i mchog tu 'di 'gyur ro/ /mi gang gis bzang sa sbyo da pa 'di thos nas/ byang chub mchog zer na sangs rgyas red/ sangs rgyas kyi rjes su rab tu mos te sangs rgyas la dad byas pa dang / len gcig tsam bzang sbyod dzade la dad pa snyeng thag pa nas byas/ bzang spyod kyi don thams cad rang gi rgyud la 'byor bar sa ga bsam slon lam tshar gcig btabs pa yin na/ bso da nams chen sa 'byung de'i bse da nams de dam pa'i mchog tu ste/ snga ma sangs rgyas zhing gi bskal pa phul ba de bas/bzang sgod la dad pa tshar gcig byas pa de/ dam pa'i mchog tu 'di 'gyur ro ste bsod nams mchog gam yag shos de bzang spyod 'don pa 'di 'gyur ro/ mchod pa phul ba de bas 'di yag gi yod red gsungs pa red/ byas

66 mkhan chen a pad rin po che/tsang bsod nams che sa red/ tshar gnyis bton na de bas che ru 'gyur/ gang gis bzang sbyod bton pa de yis bsod nams che so thob/gnyis pa sangs rgyas kyi zhal mazong ba'i phan yon/gang gis bzang bye da sgon lam 'di btab pas/ /des ni ngan song thams cad sgong bar gyur/ /des ni grogs so ngan pa spangs ba yin/ /snang ba mtha' yas de yang des myur mthong / /gang zag gang gis bzang sa byang chub semasadapa'i sbyod la sbyod pa'i smon lam 'di btab pas/ skyes bu des ni theg pa che sa lam sgrub pa la bar chad byed pa'i sdig pa'i grogs so ngan pa rnams sgong bar 'gyur ba yin/ snang ba mtha' yas rgyal ba 'od dpag me+ed de yang rgyu sgon lam 'debs mkhan des myur du mthong bar 'gyur/gsum pa byang chub sems dpa' dang bskal ba mnyam pa'i phan yodan/de dag rnyed pa rab rnyed bde bar 'tsho/ /mi tshe 'dir yang de dag legs par 'ong / /kun tu bzang po yang ci 'dra bas /de dag ring sor mi thogs de bzhin 'gyur/ /kun tu bzang sa'i smon lam 'debs mkhan de dag gis bla na ped pa'i sgon lam rnyed pas rnyed pa rab tu rnyed pa dang / bde ba ni legs pa ste sgon lam 'grub pas legs par 'tsho/ smosan lam bsnyed pa dang bsgrubs pas mi'i skye ba don yod par byas pas mi tshe 'dir yang de dag legs par 'ong / skye ba phyi

bzang sgod 'grel ba/ 67ma la yang kun tu bzang so ji lta ba de bzhin du gang zag de dag ring stor mi thogs par byang chub sems dpa' che sa chags par 'gyur gsungs pa red/bzhi pa las sgrib pa byang ba'i phan yodan/mtshams maid lnga po dag gi sdig pa rnams/ /gang gis mi shes dbang gis byas pa dag /de yis bzang sa spyod pa 'di bsdod na/ /myur du ma lus yongs su byang bar 'gyur/ / tshe 'di la thob pa'i phan ye na ni/ nyes pa che re sa pha bsad pa/ ma bsad pa la sodags pa'i mtshams sped pa lnga po dag gi sdig pa rnams/ mi gang la la las rgyu 'bras la rmongs pas bdag gi don sgrub pa'i thabs mi shes pa gti mug gis byas pa'i sdig pa rnams/ mi de yis margyasad sems che pos sgo nas bzang so sbyod pa 'di brdzod na ste bton pa yin na/ myur mgyogs du sdig pa ma lus pa yongs su byang bar 'gyur/ 'dis sdig sgrib che sa byang 'gro ba red gsungs pa red/ de yis tshe 'di la sab pa'i phan yon bstan pa red/gnyis pa phyi ma phan chad la thob pa'i phan yodan la/ gnas skabs kyi phan yon dang / mthar thug sangs rgyas pa'i phan yon gnyis/ dang sto ni/ye shes dang ni gzugs dang mtshan rnams dang / /rigs dang kha dog rnams dang ldan par 'gyur/ /bdud dang mu stegs mang stos de mi thub/ /'jig rten gsum sa kun na'ang mchod par 'gyug /ye shes zer na stong nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes thob kyi red gsungs/ gzugs

68 mkhan chen a pad rin po che/dang zhes pa de bzhag nas/ mtshan dang zhes pa de bshad na mtshan bzang so rnams kyang 'thob/ des gnas skabs su ye shes dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis mtshan bzang po rnams thob kyi red gsungs/ de nges legs kyi yon tan zer mkhan de red/ mngon mtho yi yon tan gzugs zhes pa de bshad na/ skye ba phyi rnams su mtho ris kyi yon tan gzugs yag sa mdze+es po job pa dang / rigs dang mthon po rgyal rigs lta bu dang / kha dog yag so rnams dang ldan par 'gyur gsungs/ de rang gis zob pa'i yon tan red/gzhan zil gyis gnon thub pa'i sgon lam ni/ bdud zhes pa chos sgrub pa la bar chad byed mkhan dga' rab dbang phyug lta bu bdud kyis kyang gang zag de mi thub gsungs/ bdud kyis bar chad byed pa/ dper na chos sgrub mkhan de dag la 'dod pa'i yon tan la chags pa che sto skye bcug pa lta bu/mu stegs pas kyang ba〈snal thub kyi ma red gsungs/ mu stegs pas mi thub zer na rang gi brgyud la rtag chad kyi lta ba ngan pa rnams skye mi thub gsungs pa red/ mdor na chos lugs gzhan dag de tshos rgol mi thub byas pa red/'jig rten gsum sto kun na'ang mchod par 'gyur te rang gi chos lugs byed mkhan de dag gis mchod pa byed par 'gyur/ 'jig rten gsum sto gang du skyes kyang rang sde de tshos mchod pa 'bul ba dang / 'jig rten gsum zer na kha shas kyis khams gsum la bshad kyi yod gsungs pa red/ gzugs sped khams na gzugs sped na mchod pa 'bul khag po red/ byas tsang 'jig rten gsum ste sa 'og sa steng / sa bla'i 'jig rten gsum zer na 'grig red/yang na 'dod khams kyi lha mi gnyis gzugs kyi lha dang bcas pa gsum la

bzang sgod 'grel ba/ 69bshad na yang 'grig gi red/ mdor na ga bar skyes na yang mchod pa 'bul gyi red gsungs pa red/gnyis pa mthar thug sangs rgyas pa'i phan yodan ni/ mdo 'di bton pas mthar thug rim pas rim pa sangs rgyas 'gro ba red gsungs/ mdo rkyang pa bton sdad pas sangs rgyas 'gro ba ma red de/ sangs rgyas pa la mdo 'di d+mad thabs d+mad chags sdad kyi yodad red/ des rkyen pas sangs rgyas kyi go /'phang thob 'gro ba red/ khyad par du sa dang sa thob pa'i dus su mdo 'di mang po 'don dgos red/ byang chub shing dbang drung gi sgon lam zer ba de gnad chen po/ sed thabs med red/ nged tshos maṇ+ḍal 'dra bo 'bum bsags kyi yod red/ sgon lam 'bum bsog mkhan yod sa ma red/ bzang spyodad 'bum bsags dgo/sa yin pa red/byang chub shing dbang drung du de myur 'gro/ /song nas sems can phan phyir der 'dug ste/ /byang chub sangs rgyas 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /bdud rnams sde dang bcas pa thams cad btul/ /byang chub kyi shing gi dbang po 'ar na rdo rje'i gdan gyi shing lta bu red/ de'i drung du sangs rgyas pa'i byer du bzang spyod 'don mkhan de myur du 'gro chog gi red gsungs pa red/ bdag cag gi ston pa de dang so byang chub shing drung du phebs dus lam kha nas rtswa tshong bkra shis kyis rtswa zhig 'khyer 'gro dus/sangs rgyas kyis rtswa de nga la sprad dgos kyi yod de la don dag che po yod gsungs/rtswa de phral yong dus rtswa de bsnams nas byang chub shing drung du gting

70 mkhan chen a pad rin po che/nas/ de'i steng du skyel mo krung gis bzhugs nas/ gtan 'dir bdag gis lus 'di skam kyang rung / /pags pa rus pa'i tshogs rnams zhig kyang rung / /bskal mang brnyed dka'i byang chub ma zob bar/ /gtan 'di las ni gzhan du sbyod mi ga /gdan 'di'i steng na sha med pa chags/ rus pa 'thor song na yang na byang chub ma zob bar du lang gi min gsungs dam bca' byas sgom rgyab dus sangs rgyas song ba red/ shing gi drung du song nas sems can phan pa'i phyir du der 'dug te bzhugs nas byang chub ste sangs rgyas/ chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ bdud rnams kyi sde 'khor dang bcas pa btul/ de'i nang nas bdud btul sangs rgyas zer ba de shākya thub pa lta bu zhig yin na tshul bstan pa tsam zhig red/ gzhan dag thams cad dngos gnas byang chub shing drung du sangs rgyas dgos red/gsum pa tshe 'di phyi gnyis kyi san lam gyi phan yon mdor bsdus nas bshad na/gang yang bzang so sgod pa'i sgon lam 'di/ /'chang ba dang ni ston tam 1ga na yang / /de yi rnam par smin pa'ang sangs rgyas mkhyen/ /byang chub mchosag la sodam nyi ma byed cig /gang yang bzang sa bye da pa'i sgon lam gyi glegs bam lus sa la 'chang ba zer na yang chog tsam red/ yin rgyu 'chang zer na 'dzin pa'i don dag red/bzang sgod kyi tshig blo la bzung / ston tam zer na bzang sgod kyi don dag mi la bshad pa dang / 1ga na zer na bzang spyod kyi dpe cha rmog pa dang / kha

bzang spyod 'grel ba/ 71bton zer na blo jog nas 'don pa/ de'i rnam par smin pa ste de la 'bras bu mang so yod red/ rnam smin gyi 'bras bu zer ba de mtho ris kyi rigs dang kha dog sgob pa red/ de bsam gyi mi khyab pas sangs rgyas kyis mkhyen gyi red ma gtogs gzhan dag gis shes thub kyi ma red gsungs pa red/ de nas bral ba'i 'bras bu dang rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu ni byang chub mtsho ga ste mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang red/ de thob dang mi thob bsam nas som nyi ste the tshom rtsab nas ma byed cig gsungs/ the tshom med pa dgo sa kyi yodad red chos byed pa dang las ka ga 'dra byed na yang the tshom me+ed pa'i thog nas byed dgos yin pa red/gsum pa bsngo ngab nyid kyi sgo shin tu rgyas par bshad pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i baljo ba'i rjes su 'jug pa/ rgyal bas baljos pa la 'jug pa/ de yan chad kyis phyag 'tshal sogs dge rtsadrug po de baljo ba ga 'dra byed pa'i tshul gsungs pa red/ bzang sgod kyi mdo bton pa'i dge rtsade yang bskyar du bsngo ba de la don tshan lnga yi zog nas baljo ba / dang so byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ji ltar mkhyen pa ltar gyi bajo ba ni/'jam dpal dpa' sas ji ltar mkhyen pa dang / /kun tu bzang po yang de bzhin te/ /de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag slob phyir/ /dge ba 'di dag thams cad rab tu baljo/ /'jam dpal dpa' bo 'ar dgos pa gang yin zhe na/ 'jam dpal dbyangs la ral gri bsnams rgyu yod red/ byas tsang ral gri de shes rab kyi ral gri red/

72 mkhan chen a pad rin po che/shes rab kyi ral gri des dngos por 'dzin pa'i dgra thams cad gcod cing 'joms par byed kyi yod red/ 'jam dpal dpa' sos bajo ba byed stangs ji ltar mkhyen nas bsngo sab byed pa de ga nang bzhin du/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang sa de yang 'jam dpal dbyangs de bzhin du ji ltar mkhyen nas bsngo ba byed pa/ de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag slob pa'i phyir du/ bzang sgod bton pa'i dge ba rgya che so yod pa 'di dag thams cad rab tu bsdo bar byed kyi yin gsungs/ 'jam dpal dbyangs dang kun tu bzang stos ji ltar baljo ba mdzad pa ltar du dge rtsa'adi baljo bar byed kyi yin gsungs/gnyis pa rgyal bas bsngo sa pa la 'jug pa/dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad kyis/ /bsdo ngab gang la mchog tu bsngags pa des/ /bdag gi dge ba'i rtsab 'di kun kyang / /bzang po sbyod phyir rab tu bsngo bar bgyi/ /dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad kyis baljo ba mang sa yodad pa'i nang nas 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa'i bsngo ngab gang la mchosag tu bsngags pa yis/ bdag gis bzang sgod bton pa'i dge ba'i rtsab 'di kun kyang /bzang so spyod pa ste spyir stangs sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la go rgyu yin pa red/bzang sa sangs rgyas kyi sgod pa la zer na/ de thob pa'i phyir du bsngo bar bgyi gsungs/ des sangs rgyas kyi rjes su slob pa bstan pa red/gsum pa bde ba can du skye ba'i sgon lam ni/ bzang spyodad bton pa'i dge ba'i rtsab des bde ba can du skye ba'i sgon lam/

bzang sgod 'grel ba/ 73bdag ni 'chi ba'i dus byed gyur pa na/ /sgrib pa thams cad dag nas phyir bsal te/ /mngon sum snang ba mtha' yas de masang nas/ /bde ba can gyi zhing der rab tu 'gro/ /bzang sgod bton pa'i dge ba des bde ba can du skye ba'i sgon lam ni/ bdag ni 'chi ba'i dus byed gyur pa na ste bdag 'chi 'gro ba'i tshe na/ sgrib pa thams cad dag ni ste nyon mo ngas pa'i sgrib/ las kyi sgrib pa/ rnam smin gyi sgrib pa/phyir bsal ba ste rgyang ring sor bsal bas mngon sum du snang ba mtha' yas de mthong ste skye ba phyi ma bde ba can gyi zhing der rab tu 'gro bar shogagader song nas ni sgon lam 'di dag kyang / /thams cad ma lus mngon du 'gyur bar shegag /de dag ma lus bdag gis yongs su bskang / /'jig rten ji srid sems can phan par bgyi/ /bde ba can gyi zhing der song nas sgon lam 'di dag thams cad mngon du 'gyur ba ste rdzogs par shesag cig de dag ma lus te sems can de dag ma lus pa'i re ba thams cad bdag gis yongs su bskang ste 'jig rten 'di na ji srid gnas pa de srid du/ sems can rnams la phan thogs par gyur cig gsungs/ de don tshan gsum pa bde ba can du skye ba'i sgon lam red/bzhi pa lung bstan thob pa'i sgon lam ni/ lung bstan byed zer na sangs rgyas zhig gis khyed lung pa 'di 'dra ba na sangs rgyas go 'phang thob thub kyi red gsungs pa de red/

74 mkhan chen a pad rin po che/rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzang zhing dga' ba der/ /pad+mo dam pa shin tu mdze+es las skyes/ /snang ba mtha' yas rgyal bas mngon sum du/ /lung bstan pa yang bdag gis der zob 〈snag /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor zer na sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams/ skyon me+ed pas na bzang sa/ yon tan yodad pas na dga' so/ 'khrungs sa de ma yi mngal lta bu ma yin pa rin sa che las grub pa'i pad+mo dam pa shin tu mdzes pa las skye zhing / de'i tshe snang ba mtha' yas te rgyal ba 'od dpag sed kyis mngon sum du lung bstan nas/ ma 'ongs pa na khyed sangs rgyas 'di 'dra zhig tu 'gyur 'gro zhes lung bstan pa yang / bdag gis der zhes pa ste bde ba can gyi zhing der na zob par shesag cig gsungs lung bstan zob pa'i sgon lam/lnga pa semasacan gyi don mang po byed thub pa'i sgon lam/der nas bdag gis lung bstan rab zob nas/ /sprul pa mang po dbye ba phrag brgya yis/ /blo yi stobs kyis phyogs bcu rnams su yang / /sems can rnams la phan pa mang po bgyi/ /bde ba can gyi zhing khams de nas bdag gis 'od dpag med las lung bstan rab tu zob nas/ de nas bde ba can gyi zhing rang la bzhugs sam zhe t+t+waṃ/pabye tī / bye~X bye rte pyu bye t+t+waṃ ༷ byeX ṭī bye /dze+e t+t+waṃ /༷ byedī dī t+t+waṃ/

bzang spyod 'grel ba/ 75'jig rten gyi khams rnams su sonang ste/ sems can rnams la phan pa mang po bgyi ste sgrub nus par shogag cig mdo yi re ba ngo ma de de yan chad yin pa red/gsum pa mtha' mar dge ba 'jug gi don la/ mdo bton pa'i dge ba gzhan don du bsngo ba/ mdo yi mjug byang dang gnyis las/ dngas ni/ bsod nams 'dis gnas skabs 'gro ba'i sgon lam 'grub par sgon pa/ bsod nams 'dis mthar thug 'gro ba rnams 'od dpag med kyi go 'phang thob pa'i sgon lam/ sad sgon gyis mjug bsdu ba gsum las/ dang sa rgya gar gyi 'grel ba dang 'grel bshad rnams su yang tshig bcad phyi ma gnyis po mi 'dug gsungs/ gang ltar mdo yin nam min nam/ (tā ra nā thas/ bzang sa spyod pa'i sgon lam bton pa yi sogs sho lo ka gnyis ni sdong sa bkod pa'i mdo dngos sad du yod pa 'di las mi 'byung zhing / rgya cher 'grel gzhan rnams na yang bshad pa med do/ shākya bshes gnyen gyi 'grel bar ni 'byung zhing / bzang sbyod kyi glegs bam logs su byas pa'i rgya dpe gcig la yang snang ngo / ye she sdes kyang bshad pa mdzad pas/ spyir mdo sde'i tshig ni yin par bya dgos so/debazang po dz+rad pa'i sgon lam bton pa yis/ /dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa/ /des ni 'gro ba'i sgon lam dge ba rnams/ /skad cig gcig gis thams cad 'byor bar shegag /bzang po sbyod pa'i sgon lam bton pa'i dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa ste cung zad ma gtogs zob ma red zhes pa'i don dag ma red/

76 mkhan chen a pad rin po che/dge ba yongs rdzogs sam chung mtha'am/ dge ba che phra yongs su rdzogs pas don dag 'di 'dra thob dgos gsungs pa red/ de nas ga re 'grub dgos 'dug zhe na/ 'gro ba'i sgon lam ste 'gro ba gzhan dag gis btabs pa'i slon lam/ 'gro ba gzhan dag gis kyang sgon lam sna tshogs 'debs srid pa red/thams cad ma yin pa yag sa dge ba dang mthun pa'i sgon lam de tsho/ yun ring so mi dgos pa skad cig gcig tu ste dus tshod thung thung zhig la thams cad 'byor zhes pa sgon lam thams cad 'grub par shagag cig gsungs pa red/ des gzhan dag gis sgon lam yag po btabs pa de tsho 'grub par shog cig gsungs pa red/ gnyis pa bsod nams 'dis mthar thug 'gro ba rnams 'od dpag med pa'i go 'phang thob pa'i slonagang yang bzang po sgod pa 'di baljos pas/ /bsodad nams mtha' yas dam pa gang thob des/ /'gro ba sdug bsngal chu stor bying ba rnams/ /'od dpag med pa'i gnas rab zob par pha ga /gang yang bzang sa sgod pa 'di baljos te sgon lam btabs pa de la/ bsod nams mtha' yas pa thob pa gang de yis/ gang zhig 'grub dgo sa zhe na/ 'gro ba sdug bsngal gsum gyi chu sar gnas pa'am bying ba zer na nub pa red/sdug bsngal chu bo lta bu'i nang du bying ba'am nub sdad pa'i 'khor ba'i sems can de rnams kyis/ 'od dpag me+ed pa'i gnas rab tu zob par gyur ciga'od dpag med gnas zer na zhing khams mang so la go rgyu byas na snga ma de dag dang gcig pa chag gi red/ des na 'od dpag med gnas go 'phang zob

bzang spyod 'grel ba/ 77par gyur cig gsungs na yag sa 'dug gsungs/ de rgya gar gyi gzhung nas gsungs pa red/gsum pa sod sgon gyis mjug bsdu ba/ phyi ma 'di bai ro tsā nas gsungs pa yin gsungs kyi 'dug gang byas stod pa zhig gis gsungs pa red/sgon lam rgyal po 'di dag mchosag gis gtsos/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba kun la phan byed cing / /kun tu bzang stos brgyan pa'i gzhung grub ste/ /ngan song gnas rnams ma lus stong par pe ga /sgon lam gyi rgyal sa 'di dag bton pa'i dge rtsades/ mchog gi gtso bo ra na sangs rgyas red/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par shosag cig gsungs pa red/ mtha' yas pa'i 'gro ba kun la phan pa byed par shogag cig kun tu bzang pos brgyan pa ste/ kun tu bzang sos brtsams pa'i gzhung gi don thams cad rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la thob nas 'grub par gyur cigayang na kun tu bzang sos brgyan pa'i zhing grub nas zhes gsungs pa yod red gsungs mkhan 'dug zhing zer na bde ba can gyi zhing du skye nas zhes pa'i don dag red/ phyogs bcu'i ngan song gi gnas rnams ma lus pa thams cad stong par shesag cig gam/ ngan song gnas rnams med par gyur cig gsungs pa red/gnyis pa mdo yi 'jug byang sgos pa/'phags pa bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi rgyal sto rdzogs so/ /bzang sgod de ljon ma mkhan po ngag dbang dri med kun ldan gyi mdun nas
